BRIDGE'in ülkelerin önceliklerini finansmana hazır projelere dönüştürmesine ve bu projeleri yatırımcılarla buluşturmasına yardımcı olacağını belirten Şimşek, üç öneri sundu: Temiz enerji, dayanıklı altyapı ve sürdürülebilir sanayi alanlarında ortak proje portföyü oluşturulması. İhracat kredileri, kalkınma finansmanı ve ticari kredilerin ortak finansman modeliyle bir araya getirilmesi. Ülkelerin ve iş dünyasının projelere ilk aşamadan itibaren dahil edilmesi. Şimşek, iklim ve kalkınma hedeflerinin birlikte ilerlemesi gerektiğini belirterek, yatırımların gelişmekte olan ekonomilerde uygun fiyatlı enerji, güvenilir altyapı, istihdam ve dayanıklılık sağlamasının önemini vurguladı.

news.title: US envoys head to meet Zelensky after talks with Putin in Moscow
news.summary: US envoy Steve Witkoff says President Putin has agreed to European negotiators joining the next round of Ukraine talks.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: US envoys head to meet Zelensky after talks with Putin in Moscow
news.summaryTr: US envoy Steve Witkoff says President Putin has agreed to European negotiators joining the next round of Ukraine talks.
news.articleText: US envoys head to meet Zelensky after talks with Putin in Moscow - Published US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff held a fresh round of talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow, a day after the latest discussions aimed at ending the war in Ukraine wrapped up in Abu Dhabi. The pair are now flying to Dublin to meet Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky, and Witkoff said a new round of trilateral talks had already been agreed with Putin. Earlier on Thursday Zelensky said Ukraine's military was again facing "systematic" restrictions to Starlink's military-grade satellite service, Starshield, meaning Kyiv was struggling to intercept Russian jet-powered drones. The talks in the Emirates were framed as being centred around European security arrangements in a post-war scenario, although a resolution to the war sparked by Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022 still appears distant. Comments by both President Vladimir Putin and Kremlin officials suggest that Russia's position on the war has not shifted, and that Moscow's demands for territory and neutrality continue to far exceed what Ukraine is prepared to consider. Witkoff said that Europeans would join the next round of talks. "They are our partners and it's important to us that they take part," Witkoff told Russian state TV after meeting Putin in the Kremlin. Zelensky said Ukraine was trying to clear up the Starlink situation with the American side but added "some things" were already clear: "If someone in America is making decisions that basically treat Ukrainian territory as if it is not Ukrainian, then this tells us where things are going." He did not elaborate further. Starshield was developed by Elon Musk's SpaceX company for government and military use. Along with Starlink, it has come to play a vital role in facilitating communication on Ukraine's front line. A similar issue with connectivity affected the front line in late October and lasted about a week before it was fixed and it remained unclear who had ordered the temporary restrictions. - Why is Ukraine so reliant on Starlink and can Europe plug the gap? - Published25 October Zelensky said the current disruption had been ongoing for several days and was "helping the Russians kill more Ukrainians and carry out more accurate strikes against Ukraine". Meanwhile, some of the longstanding roadblocks in the peace process were addressed during the US-Russia talks in the Kremlin. The territorial issue continues to be a key point of contention, Putin said. "For us there is only one line of demarcation: the line of the state border. Because then it will be clear that we are here, and you are there. As soon as we start discussing 'grey zones'… arguments immediately start and any agreements become unstable. And there will be no lasting peace." He also suggested organising a humanitarian truce to allow for the evacuation of hundreds of civilians from a frontline area, on the model of last month's ceasefire in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky. Putin suggested a similar five-day ceasefire for Kostyantynivka, a contested front-line Ukrainian city in the eastern region of Donetsk. Kyiv disputes that Russia fully holds the town, and a truce could help Moscow's troops to make a final push to seize it. "Considering that they brought in equipment and rotated troops in Oleshky under the guise of a humanitarian operation, it's clear what they want in Kostyantynivka," Ukrainian presidential adviser Dmitry Lytvyn told the BBC, adding that the details would need to be "clarified". But at the core of this week's talks has been the issue of European security architecture. Earlier Kushner said the US hoped to "create a new framework" of security between Ukraine, Russia and Europe that could "secure lasting peace", while Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov said it was "clear that the current system does not work." Ukraine and Europe have long been concerned about the current US administration's commitment to European security and its softening towards the Kremlin and that decisions about their continent could be made without them. Zelensky said he found the US approach of discussing a new European security order with Russia "a bit strange". "It is a significant shift in the US position that the US has now taken on board the Russian demand that the European security architecture needs to be discussed and agreed upon in parallel with the Ukraine peace talks," said the Director of the Estonian Foreign Policy Institute Kristi Raik. She said the Russians have a "long history" of wanting to revise European security architecture, intended as core principles "like sovereignty, territorial integrity, the principle that there is no use of force to some conflicts". Russia "has long looked to reduced Nato presence on the Eastern flank and that… get some kind of veto rights in decisions concerning European security and defence," Raik said. "And that's where it gets even more difficult to imagine that there could be an agreement between the Europeans and the Russians." On Thursday, Putin again repeated that the presence of foreign troops in Ukraine was "unacceptable" to Russia, and said Russia would like the Americans to engage with Europe "so that the Europeans can decide what they truly want: peace or war". During the first years of the war, Europeans cut communications with the Kremlin and refused to engage with Russia directly. That position has now shifted for many as concern that decisions about the European continent could be made without European involvement. Kushner also urged Europe to "identify one person to speak on their behalf" in the negotiations. But the Kremlin has not confirmed the make-up of next week's talks, and at the start of the meeting, Putin had indicated he didn't want European countries to play a full role. The Russians have long cited Europe's support for Kyiv as an obstacle to their involvement. Speaking to Kushner and Witkoff, Putin said he was encouraging them "to work with your European allies so that they finally decide whether they want peace or war in Ukraine." news.title: Trump'tan Nvidia'nın yeni CEO'su için sürpriz öneri: Apple'dan o ismi işaret etti
news.summary: ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Jensen Huang'ın istifasının ardından Nvidia CEO'luğu için Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook'u önerdi. Trump, "Bir efsanenin yerini başka bir efsane alıyor" ifadelerini kullandı.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Trump'tan Nvidia'nın yeni CEO'su için sürpriz öneri: Apple'dan o ismi işaret etti
news.summaryTr: ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Jensen Huang'ın istifasının ardından Nvidia CEO'luğu için Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook'u önerdi. Trump, "Bir efsanenin yerini başka bir efsane alıyor" ifadelerini kullandı.
news.articleText: Trump'tan Nvidia'nın yeni CEO'su için sürpriz öneri: Apple'dan o ismi işaret etti - ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Jensen Huang'ın istifasının ardından Nvidia CEO'luğu için Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook'u önerdi. - Trump, "Bir efsanenin yerini başka bir efsane alıyor." ifadelerini kullandı. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang'ın görevinden ayrılmasının ardından şirketin yeni CEO'su için dikkat çeken bir isim önerdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Trump, Truth Social hesabından yaptığı paylaşımda, Huang'ın görev süresince "harika" işler yaptığını belirterek, yerine Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook'un geçmesi gerektiğini savundu. Trump, "Jensen Huang istifa ettiğine göre, onun yerini alabilecek tek bir kişi var, Apple'dan Tim Cook. Bir efsanenin yerini başka bir efsane alıyor." değerlendirmesinde bulundu. Nvidia'da geçici CEO Colette Kress oldu Nvidia, Jensen Huang'ın başkanlık, üst yöneticilik ve yönetim kurulu üyeliği görevlerinden derhal geçerli olmak üzere ayrıldığını açıklamıştı. Şirketin başkan yardımcısı ve Finans Direktörü (CFO) Colette Kress'in geçici CEO olarak görev yapmayı kabul ettiği bildirilmişti. Huang'ın istifası, hakkında evlilik dışı iki ilişki yaşadığına ilişkin haberlerin ardından geldi. Söz konusu haberlerde, kadınlardan birinin Çin adına istihbarat topladığı da iddia edilmişti.

news.title: Zelenskiy Avrupa'yı devreye sokmak istiyor: Rusya ile görüşmelerde yeni talep
news.summary: Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy, Rusya-Ukrayna savaşının sona erdirilmesine yönelik müzakerelerde Avrupa'nın daimi olarak yer alması gerektiğini söyledi. Zelenskiy, hava savunması ve enerji desteği için Avrupalı liderlere çağrıda bulundu.

news.titleTr: Zelenskiy Avrupa'yı devreye sokmak istiyor: Rusya ile görüşmelerde yeni talep
news.summaryTr: Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy, Rusya-Ukrayna savaşının sona erdirilmesine yönelik müzakerelerde Avrupa'nın daimi olarak yer alması gerektiğini söyledi. Zelenskiy, hava savunması ve enerji desteği için Avrupalı liderlere çağrıda bulundu.
news.articleText: Zelenskiy Avrupa'yı devreye sokmak istiyor: Rusya ile görüşmelerde yeni talep - Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy, Rusya-Ukrayna savaşının sona erdirilmesine yönelik müzakerelerde Avrupa'nın daimi olarak yer alması gerektiğini söyledi. - Zelenskiy, hava savunması ve enerji desteği için Avrupalı liderlere çağrıda bulundu. Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy, Avrupa'nın Rusya-Ukrayna savaşını sona erdirmeye yönelik müzakerelerde kalıcı şekilde yer alması gerektiğini belirtti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İrlanda'nın başkenti Dublin'de düzenlenen Avrupa Siyasi Topluluğu (AST) 9. Zirvesi'nin açılışında konuşan Zelenskiy, Rusya'da bulunan ABD heyetinin akşam saatlerinde Dublin'e geleceğini ve görüşmelerin sonuçlarını burada ele alacaklarını bildirdi. Avrupa'nın Rusya'nın da bulunduğu müzakere masasında doğrudan yer almasa da sürece dolaylı biçimde dahil olmasını olumlu değerlendiren Zelenskiy, "Avrupa'nın müzakerelerin daimi unsuru olmasını sağlamalıyız." dedi. Abu Dabi görüşmelerinde esir takası gündemdeydi Birleşik Arap Emirlikleri'nin (BAE) başkenti Abu Dabi'de gerçekleştirilen görüşmelerin ciddi geçtiğini belirten Zelenskiy, esir takası konusunda sağlanan mutabakatın önemine dikkati çekti. Güvenlik garantilerine ilişkin görüşmelerde Avrupa ile Rusya arasında yeni bir güvenlik mimarisi oluşturulması ihtimalinin de gündeme geldiğini aktaran Zelenskiy, bu yaklaşımı "tuhaf" bulduklarını ifade etti. Ukrayna heyetinin Karadeniz'de gerilimi azaltacak ve enerji altyapısına yönelik saldırıları durduracak adımlar önerdiğini belirten Zelenskiy, Rus heyetinin bu konuları görüşme yetkisi bulunmadığını söylediğini aktardı. Zelenskiy'den Patriot, NASAMS ve F-16 mühimmatı talebi Ukrayna'nın öncelikleri arasında hava savunma sistemleri için mühimmat tedariki ve enerji ihtiyacının karşılanmasının bulunduğunu belirten Zelenskiy, Patriot ve NASAMS sistemleri ile F-16 savaş uçakları için mühimmat desteğine ihtiyaç duyduklarını söyledi. Zelenskiy, bu başlıklarda Avrupalı liderlerden destek istedi.

news.title: Enflasyon ne zaman düşecek? IMF, ABD için tarihi açıkladı
news.summary: IMF Sözcüsü Julie Kozack, ABD'de enflasyonun yüzde 2'lik hedefe 2028'in ortasında gerilemesini beklediklerini açıkladı. Kozack, yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki olası değişimlerin de enflasyon üzerinde etkili olabileceğini belirtti.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Enflasyon ne zaman düşecek? IMF, ABD için tarihi açıkladı
news.summaryTr: IMF Sözcüsü Julie Kozack, ABD'de enflasyonun yüzde 2'lik hedefe 2028'in ortasında gerilemesini beklediklerini açıkladı. Kozack, yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki olası değişimlerin de enflasyon üzerinde etkili olabileceğini belirtti.
news.articleText: Enflasyon ne zaman düşecek? IMF, ABD için tarihi açıkladı - IMF Sözcüsü Julie Kozack, ABD'de enflasyonun yüzde 2'lik hedefe 2028'in ortasında gerilemesini beklediklerini açıkladı. - Kozack, yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki olası değişimlerin de enflasyon üzerinde etkili olabileceğini belirtti. Uluslararası Para Fonu (IMF) Sözcüsü Julie Kozack, ABD'de enflasyonun yüzde 2'lik hedefe 2028'in ortasında ulaşmasını beklediklerini bildirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Basın toplantısında küresel ekonomiye ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulunan Kozack, ABD'de manşet enflasyonun hedefin üzerinde kalmaya devam ettiğini söyledi. Bu durumun Ortadoğu'daki savaşın yol açtığı emtia fiyatı şoku ve hizmet sektöründeki katı enflasyondan kaynaklandığını belirten Kozack, mevcut tahminlerin enflasyonun 2028'in ortasında yüzde 2'ye gerileyeceğine işaret ettiğini kaydetti. Son dönemdeki enflasyonist baskıların artan iş gücü maliyetlerinden kaynaklandığını düşünmediklerini ifade eden Kozack, enflasyonun hedefin üzerinde kalmasının arkasında başka faktörlerin bulunduğunu dile getirdi. IMF'den Fed'in sıkı para politikasına destek Kozack, ABD Merkez Bankasının (Fed) para politikasında sıkılaştırma sürecini uygun şekilde başlattığını belirtti. Dezenflasyon sürecinin desteklenmesi ve enflasyonun yeniden hedefe çekilmesi için önümüzdeki dönemde kısıtlayıcı para politikası duruşunun gerekli olacağını söyleyen Kozack, Fed'in fiyat istikrarına odaklanmasını ve gerektiğinde harekete geçmeye hazır olmasını desteklediklerini vurguladı. Yapay zeka yatırımları enflasyonu etkileyebilir Yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki olası değişimlerin enflasyona etkisine de değinen Kozack, enerji fiyatlarındaki şok ile yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki patlamanın küresel ekonomiyi etkileyen iki önemli güç olduğunu söyledi. Bu iki gelişmenin küresel büyümeyi farklı yönlere çektiğini ancak her ikisinin de enflasyonist etkiler yaratabildiğini belirten Kozack, yapay zeka yatırımlarına ilişkin beklentilerdeki olası bir değişikliğin enflasyonu da etkileyebileceğini ifade etti. IMF'nin yapay zekanın finansal istikrar üzerindeki olası risklerini yakından izlediğini aktaran Kozack, özellikle siber riskler, piyasa hareketleri ve hisse senedi piyasalarındaki oynaklığa odaklandıklarını kaydetti. Yüksek piyasa değerlemeleri yakından izleniyor Kozack, bazı piyasalarda değerlemelerin yüksek seviyelerde kalmayı sürdürdüğüne dikkati çekti. Yapay zeka yatırımlarının uzun vadeli kârlılığına ilişkin beklentilerin yeniden değerlendirilmesinin piyasalarda risk oluşturabileceğini belirten Kozack, bu alandaki gelişmeleri yakından takip ettiklerini söyledi. IMF Sözcüsü, yapay zekanın küresel büyümeyi destekleme potansiyelinin yanı sıra verimlilik, iş gücü piyasaları ve finansal istikrar üzerindeki olası etkilerinin de kurumun gündeminde olduğunu bildirdi.

news.title: Putin-Trump hattında kritik gelişme: Ukrayna için yeni toplantı tarihi
news.summary: ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın Özel Temsilcisi Steve Witkoff, Rusya Devlet Başkanı Vladimir Putin ile Moskova'da gerçekleştirdiği görüşmenin ardından ilerleme kaydedildiğini açıkladı. Witkoff, üçlü görüşmelerin yeniden başlayacağını ve yeni bir toplantı tarihi belirlendiğini bildirdi.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Putin-Trump hattında kritik gelişme: Ukrayna için yeni toplantı tarihi
news.summaryTr: ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın Özel Temsilcisi Steve Witkoff, Rusya Devlet Başkanı Vladimir Putin ile Moskova'da gerçekleştirdiği görüşmenin ardından ilerleme kaydedildiğini açıkladı. Witkoff, üçlü görüşmelerin yeniden başlayacağını ve yeni bir toplantı tarihi belirlendiğini bildirdi.
news.articleText: Putin-Trump hattında kritik gelişme: Ukrayna için yeni toplantı tarihi - ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın Özel Temsilcisi Steve Witkoff, Rusya Devlet Başkanı Vladimir Putin ile Moskova'da gerçekleştirdiği görüşmenin ardından ilerleme kaydedildiğini açıkladı. - Witkoff, üçlü görüşmelerin yeniden başlayacağını ve yeni bir toplantı tarihi belirlendiğini bildirdi. Rusya Devlet Başkanı Vladimir Putin ile ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın Özel Temsilcisi Steve Witkoff, Moskova'da bir araya geldi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Görüşmenin ardından Vnukovo Havalimanı'nda basın mensuplarına açıklamalarda bulunan Witkoff, temaslarda ilerleme sağlandığını söyledi. CNN'in haberine göre Witkoff, müzakerelerin yeniden başlamasının önemli bir gelişme olduğunu belirterek, "İnsanlar üçlü görüşmeleri yeniden başlatacağımızı düşünmüyordu. Yeniden başlattık. Yeni bir toplantı tarihi belirledik." ifadelerini kullandı. Yeni görüşmelere Avrupalı temsilciler de katılacak Witkoff, gelecek görüşmelere Avrupalı temsilcilerin de katılacağını doğruladı. Avrupa temsilcilerinin müzakere sürecinde yer almasının önemli olduğunu vurguladı. Görüşmede Trump'ın damadı ve Özel Temsilcisi Jared Kushner de yer aldı. Kushner, temasların kapsamlı ve ayrıntılı geçtiğini belirterek, yapılan görüşmelerin ilerideki çok taraflı toplantılara katkı sağlamasını umduğunu söyledi. ABD heyeti Zelenskiy ile görüşecek Moskova'daki temasların ardından ABD temsilcilerinin İrlanda'nın başkenti Dublin'e gitmesi bekleniyor. Heyetin burada Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy ile bir araya gelerek Putin ile yapılan görüşmenin sonuçları hakkında bilgi vermesi öngörülüyor. Görüşmelerin ardından Ukrayna'daki savaşın sona erdirilmesine yönelik diplomatik sürecin nasıl ilerleyeceği ve yeni toplantının hangi tarihte yapılacağı takip edilecek. Ukrayna'daki savaşın sona erdirilmesine yönelik diplomatik temaslarda ABD, Rusya ve Ukrayna arasındaki görüşmelerin yanı sıra Avrupa ülkelerinin sürece katılımı da önem taşıyor. Yeni toplantıya Avrupalı temsilcilerin dahil edilmesi, müzakerelerin daha geniş bir çerçevede yürütülmesine yönelik bir adım olarak öne çıkıyor.

news.title: Borsada 47 hissede özel emir hareketliliği: SASA, ASTOR, TUPRS, HEKTS ve KTLEV de listede
news.summary: Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksinin yüzde 1,24 yükselişle günü tamamladığı 12 Kasım Perşembe günü, 47 hisse senedinde özel emir yöntemiyle işlem gerçekleştirildi.

news.titleTr: Borsada 47 hissede özel emir hareketliliği: SASA, ASTOR, TUPRS, HEKTS ve KTLEV de listede
news.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksinin yüzde 1,24 yükselişle günü tamamladığı 12 Kasım Perşembe günü, 47 hisse senedinde özel emir yöntemiyle işlem gerçekleştirildi.
news.articleText: Borsada 47 hissede özel emir hareketliliği: SASA, ASTOR, TUPRS, HEKTS ve KTLEV de listede YAYIN TARİHİ, 12 Kasım 2026 20:36GÜNCELLEME, 12 Kasım 2026 20:37 PAYLAŞ Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksinin yüzde 1,24 yükselişle günü tamamladığı 12 Kasım Perşembe günü, 47 hisse senedinde özel emir yöntemiyle işlem gerçekleştirildi. BIST 100’ün yüzde 1,24 yükseldiği günde 47 hisse senedinde özel emirle işlem gerçekleştirildi. 12 Kasım 2026 tarihinde özel emir yöntemiyle gerçekleştirilen işlemlerin detayları şöyle: Özel emir işlemi nedir? Özel emir, hisse senedinde alıcı ve satıcının karşılıklı anlaşmasıyla, borsada o anda oluşan fiyatlardan bağımsız olarak belirlenen fiyat üzerinden gerçekleştirilen işlemdir. Bu emirlerde işlem yapılacak karşı yatırım kuruluşu, nominal tutar, fiyat, valör ve sermaye piyasası aracı belirtilir. Özel emir yalnızca işlemin karşı tarafı olarak belirlenen yatırım kuruluşu tarafından görüntülenebilir. Bazı yüksek tutarlı işlemlerin ardından alıcı ve satıcı taraflar pay alım satım bildirimlerini Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımlayabilir. Bildirim yapılmadığı durumlarda işlemin hangi yatırımcılar tarafından gerçekleştirildiğinin bilinmesi mümkün değildir.

news.titleTr: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say
news.summaryTr: The proposed radical overhaul of the welfare system would move under-25s off the main sickness benefits.
news.articleText: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say - Published Some young people could see reductions to the benefits they are entitled to under a radical overhaul of the welfare system to be recommended by a government-commissioned review. As reported in the Times,, external Alan Milburn's year-long report, to be published on Tuesday, is expected to recommend moving under-25s off the main sickness and disability benefits. Milburn, a former Labour health secretary, has been tasked by the government with helping reduce the one in eight 16 to 24 year-olds in the UK who are not in education, employment or training - otherwise known as "Neet". He said on Wednesday night that his plans would not be "pain-free" and would affect both existing and new claimants. His report is expected to say that under-25s should no longer be able to claim the health element of UK-wide universal credit - or personal independence payment (Pip), the main disability benefit in England and Wales. Disabled people in Scotland can claim the devolved Adult Disability Payment. Instead, under Milburn's plan, under-25s would receive an allowance on the same basic rate as universal credit. Some could be eligible for a new "additional cost allowance" to cover day-to-day costs related to their conditions. Some claimants would receive less under the plans - although the exact amounts will not be clear until early next year, when the government publishes legislation to implement the changes. People can claim Pip to help them with the additional cost of being disabled or living with long-term physical or mental health conditions. It is available to those both in and out of work. In his interim report,, external Milburn said survey data found that 19% of young people claiming disability or health benefits were in work. Milburn, a Labour MP from 1992 to 2010, is also expected to recommend an investment of billions into more employment support for young people, including work placements, job subsidies and one-to-one personal advisers. Those with more severe disabilities and unable to work would get a new benefit paid at a higher rate. Milburn told the Times: "Candidly, it could mean that some people will get less financial support at the beginning of their benefit claim than under the current system. "But actually, for young people, there's a different debate that we've got to resolve, which is whether the priority is their longer-term life chances or just their immediate shorter-term finances. "I think what the current system does [is] it prioritises the latter over the former. I believe that's the wrong choice and it needs to be the other way around." Just under one million young people in the UK are Neets, data from the Office for National Statistics (ONS) from April to June suggests. This was a rise of 3% on the same period last year. Milburn's recommendations are likely to be backed by Prime Minister Andy Burnham but could prove controversial among Labour MPs, who opposed welfare changes last year under his predecessor Sir Keir Starmer. Dame Meg Hillier, who helped spearhead a backbench rebellion against Starmer's reforms, suggested she and her colleagues were broadly supportive this time around. "What happened last year was a cut was being proposed and none of us could explain to people what would happen to them," the Labour MP told the BBC. "Milburn has done some very good work on this so I'm giving him a fair wind," she added. But Bell Ribeiro-Addy, one of the Labour backbenchers who revolted last year, said she was "not sure" she could vote to cut the benefit entitlement of existing claimants. 'Cannot assume' Tom Ashforth, a 19-year-old student at Sheffield Hallam University, receives both components of Pip at the higher rate. He said the financial support helps him manage additional expenses linked to his visual impairment, including prescriptions, mobility aids and accessible learning resources. "If I were to lose it, I would struggle to afford essential things," he said. He said he believes decisions over disability benefits should be made on a case-by-case basis, rather than according to age. "You cannot assume that everyone under the age of 25 is in the same position," he said. In his Times interview, Milburn acknowledged that changing the rules for existing claimants would be "difficult politically" but stressed it was necessary. 'Rebuilding system from scratch' James Taylor, from disability equality charity Scope, said Pip was a "lifeline" and restricting access to it "won't make young disabled people's extra costs disappear". Harriet Edwards, from the charity Sense, said changes were "long overdue", but that without additional details, families were "deeply anxious". A government spokesperson said: "We will always ensure there is a safety net for the most vulnerable and those who are unable to work." The reforms would represent a radical overhaul of Britain's welfare system, at a time when there is heavy political pressure for the UK to find the money to spend more on defence. Both the Conservatives and Reform UK have argued for significant cuts to welfare, including to fund a boost to defence. Responding on Thursday, Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said the government should not be spending "lots of time" on employment schemes, which she said would ultimately fail. If Milburn's recommendations were approved, it could take almost a decade for the British state to see monetary savings. The new system "will need significant investment" and would involve "rebuilding the system from scratch", Milburn said. His new proposed system would involve an element of carrot and stick, wherein young people could lose some of their benefits if they did not engage with the extra work support options. In an interview recorded on Tuesday, Skills Minister Jacqui Smith told the BBC that young people had a "responsibility" to take up employment support. "It is a contract. People need the chance, and they need to take that chance," she added. A separate review - co-chaired by disabilities minister Sir Stephen Timms - examining disability benefits is also expected to be published this month. news.summaryTr: İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi (İBB) Meclisi'nde, 19 ilçe belediyesinin 2027 yılı bütçesi kabul edildi. Kadıköy 19,1 milyar lirayla en yüksek bütçeye sahip ilçe olurken, Şile 3,5 milyar lirayla listenin son sırasında yer aldı.
news.articleText: İstanbul'da 19 ilçenin bütçe sıralaması belli oldu: Zirvede hangi belediye var? İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi (İBB) Meclisi'nde, 19 ilçe belediyesinin 2027 yılı bütçesi kabul edildi. Kadıköy 19,1 milyar lirayla en yüksek bütçeye sahip ilçe olurken, Şile 3,5 milyar lirayla listenin son sırasında yer aldı. İstanbul'da 19 ilçenin 2027 bütçesi kabul edildi İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi (İBB) Meclisi'nde, 19 ilçe belediyesinin 2027 mali yılı bütçeleri kabul edildi. İBB Meclisi kasım ayı toplantılarının üçüncü oturumu, Meclis 2. Başkanvekili Gencay Özcan başkanlığında Saraçhane'deki belediye binasında gerçekleştirildi. Toplantıda Gaziosmanpaşa, Küçükçekmece, Sultanbeyli ve Üsküdar'ın da aralarında bulunduğu 19 ilçenin gelecek yıl için hazırlanan bütçeleri görüşüldü. Yapılan oylamanın ardından bütçelerin tamamı kabul edildi. Kadıköy ilk sırada, Şile son sırada Kabul edilen bütçeler arasında en yüksek tutar 19 milyar 100 milyon lirayla Kadıköy Belediyesi'ne ait oldu. Kadıköy'ü 16,5 milyar lirayla Ümraniye ve 16,2 milyar lirayla Üsküdar izledi. Şile Belediyesi ise 3 milyar 520 milyon 674 bin liralık bütçeyle listede en düşük bütçeye sahip ilçe oldu. 19 ilçenin 2027 yılı bütçeleri İBB Meclisinde kabul edilen ilçe belediyelerinin 2027 yılı bütçeleri şöyle: İlçe belediyelerinin yıllık bütçeleri; personel giderleri, altyapı yatırımları, sosyal hizmetler, ulaşım ve kentsel hizmetler gibi harcama kalemlerini kapsıyor. 2027 bütçeleri, belediyelerin gelecek yılki hizmet ve yatırım planlarının mali çerçevesini oluşturacak.

news.title: The rise and fall of Jensen Huang - how the tech superstar became mired in scandal
news.summary: Within days, Huang's status as a seemingly untouchable figure leading the global tech race has crumbled.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: The rise and fall of Jensen Huang - how the tech superstar became mired in scandal
news.summaryTr: Within days, Huang's status as a seemingly untouchable figure leading the global tech race has crumbled.
news.articleText: The rise and fall of Jensen Huang - how the tech superstar became mired in scandal - Published Jensen Huang, known for sporting a black leather jacket to shareholder events, appeared to have it all. He was courted by leaders in the US and China alike, worshipped by investors and seen as a loyal family man. But a rockstar approach to his personal life has ultimately led to his resignation. The 63-year-old has been married since 1985, long before the foundation of Nvidia, the company that propelled him to tech stardom. He is known as a workaholic and a demanding manager, with high standards for those who worked for him, which included his own children, promoted within the company. But he has seen his personal reputation go into freefall this week, undone by romantic entanglements that throw doubt on his focus and his judgement. On Thursday, he resigned following back-to-back revelations of two affairs. News of the first - a relationship with a businesswoman alleged to be a Chinese spy - ricocheted around the world, raising eyebrows among investors. It was followed on Wednesday by reports that the tech boss had also had an affair with an Nvidia colleague. His departure creates uncertainty in the global stock market, which was already knocked-off balance in recent weeks. Nvidia is a linchpin in the US's race for technology leadership with China. Huang may not be a household name on the same level as Elon Musk or Mark Zuckerberg. But his role in the tech industry, especially in relation to the explosion of artificial intelligence in the last three years, may prove more consequential. Nvidia dominates the market for the microchips that are used to power the new technology. The company, which is still valued at nearly $4n (£3.02tn) despite recent events, is at the centre of the AI race between the US and China, the world's tech and economic powerhouses. Huang enjoyed access to the seats of political power on an unrivalled scale, being courted by both US President Donald Trump and China's President Xi Jinping. His remarkable rise to the top of his profession has led to him being dubbed the "Taylor Swift of tech" and seen him amass an estimated fortune of $145bn, according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. Despite always donning his trademark all-black outfits and taking a playful approach to investor presentations, Huang has worked for years to present himself as a family man, someone who exemplified the American Dream. Born in Taiwan in 1963, Huang and his family moved to the west coast of the US when he was nine years old. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a Master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. It was at college where he met his wife, Lori Mills. The pair were lab partners and married in 1985, eight years before Huang founded Nvidia. They have two children, Madison and Spencer, who now both work in senior roles at Nvidia. The company became a key provider of the computer chips and circuits used for gaming before it expanded in a new direction. It now creates the key processing chips used to power the growing AI technology. Huang has hailed AI as a "new industrial revolution" that is on par with the advent of electricity. Nvidia is the world's second most valuable company and its customers include the biggest firms on the planet, Google, Meta, Amazon, Microsoft, SpaceX, Tesla, OpenAI and Anthropic, all spending big on its products. So it is no surprise that at a recent AI summit at the White House, Huang was picked out from a group of 42 to flank the president, alongside Elon Musk, both men with whom Trump has famously close relationships. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on Jensen Huang, told the BBC, referring to the late boss of Apple. He added that Huang was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. He described him as a "demanding" boss, who "really pushes his people to the limit". But while the former Nvidia CEO is "very brilliant" and a "world-class computer scientist", there's also "a level of arrogance" and "a level of self-deception as well", he said. Huang had gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, he added, something that was "very important to him". "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," Witt added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad." First reports emerged on 29 October in the New York Times that Huang had conducted a relationship with Alice Huang, no relation. US officials allege the businesswoman associated with Singapore-based firm Megaspeed is a Chinese intelligence asset. After the revelations of the first affair, Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting their family. Trump, as well as other leaders in the AI tech industry, initially backed Huang to continue in his role at Nvidia. The president described him as "honourable". But the reporting of a second affair, with Kimberly Powell, vice president of healthcare who has worked at Nvidia for 18 years, prompted a board meeting, followed by the announcement Huang was stepping down. In the aftermath of that news Trump said Huang had done "a fantastic job" and proposed Tim Cook of Apple as a suitable replacement at the head of Nvidia.

news.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says

news.titleTr: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
news.summaryTr: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.
news.articleText: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says - Published Six people have been killed and about 30 injured in an Israeli air strike on Nasser hospital in the southern Gaza Strip, the Hamas-run health ministry says. The hospital's director said two missiles hit a building containing surgical wards and intensive care units overnight, but that one of the missiles did not explode. The health ministry said medical staff, patients and companions were killed, among them surgeon Dr Rizq Abu Shaira. It condemned the attack as a "flagrant violation of international laws and conventions". The Israeli military said it targeted a commander of Hamas's armed wing and other fighters who had used the hospital as a "headquarters" to plan attacks on its forces. Hamas said that Israel was spreading "false narratives" in a "blatant attempt to cover up a new war crime". Under international law, hospitals have a protected status, but they have been repeatedly targeted during the Gaza war. Israel accuses Hamas, which retains security control of parts of Gaza not occupied by Israeli troops, of cynically exploiting civilian infrastructure. It says the group stores weapons and runs command and control rooms in hospitals, which Hamas denies. Israel does not allow international news organisations, including the BBC, into Gaza, making it difficult to verify what is happening in the territory. The Nasser Medical Complex is located in the city of Khan Younis and is the largest hospital in southern Gaza, serving almost one million people. In a video posted on social media, a paramedic from the Hamas-run Civil Defence agency who arrived at the building after the strike early on Thursday said a missile penetrated the five-storey structure and hit a room in the surgical department. Other footage shared by activists showed thick smoke inside the building and extensive destruction on the second floor, where medical equipment and beds had been scattered by an explosion. The hospital's director, Dr Ahmed al-Fara, later told a news conference that Israeli forces had fired two missiles at the al-Yasin surgery building but that only one exploded. "What's happened in Nasser Medical Complex is targeting the health sector mainly. We are talking about doctors, we are talking about civilians, we are talking about patients," he said. "Also, there is... huge damage [to] the infrastructure inside the hospital." Footage filmed by a freelance journalist working for the BBC showed extensive damage to an operating theatre, wards and a sleeping area for medics, as well as hallways and lifts. News agencies also published photos that appeared to show an unexploded missile. Dr Mohammed Qdeih, a general surgery specialist who was wounded in the head, said he and other medical staff had just finished work around 00:30 and had been preparing to go to sleep when there was an explosion. "My whole body was trapped under the rubble. For a moment, I felt as if I was about to lose consciousness, or that I was about to die," he told the BBC. "I started struggling to free myself and started calling out, 'Guys! Guys!' I began crawling, trying to pull my leg out from beneath the rubble. I managed to pull myself free. It was dark, there were no lights, nothing at all." He said he had been lying in a bed near Dr Rizq Abu Shaira, who was killed. Another colleague suffered a broken leg. "Dr Rizq was the kindest person in this department. He was very kind and always willing to help... And of course, he was a surgeon, one of the best among us." He added: "Patients were killed as well. There were patients in the rooms next to us who were killed. A patient comes to the hospital seeking treatment and leaves carried on people's shoulders. I do not know what kind of humanity this is." The Israeli military said in a statement that its "precise strike" had targeted the commander of Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade, who it named as Mohammed Abu Ismail, alongside other fighters who were "hiding inside" Nasser hospital. "The terrorists were struck in order to remove the threat they posed after turning the Nasser hospital compound into a headquarters and operating from there to advance dozens of terrorist plots against our forces and restore the brigade's force," it alleged. The military added that it had issued advance warnings before the strike and released an audio recording of what it said was one given to a senior Gaza health official. But Fara insisted the hospital had received no warning of an attack. A Hamas statement rejected the Israeli military's accusations, calling them "a blatant attempt to justify a documented crime targeting a civilian medical facility whose function and purpose are well known". "The nature of the targeted site and the casualties inflicted on patients, doctors and medical staff expose the falsity and weakness of this narrative," it said. However, local activists circulated claims overnight that the strike may have targeted a senior Hamas security figure who was hiding inside the building. Fara said this was the seventh time that Nasser hospital had been struck during the war. In August 2025, a double Israeli strike killed 22 Palestinians, including journalists and health workers. The World Health Organization (WHO) said it had documented a total of 1,056 attacks on healthcare in Gaza over the past three years, resulting in 1,010 deaths. "Gaza's health facilities are lifelines for its people. They must be protected. They must never be militarized or attacked," warned Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, the UN agency's director general. Later on Thursday, at least four more Palestinians were reportedly killed in separate incidents in northern and central Gaza. Medics said three were killed in Israeli air strikes in Gaza City, Jabalia and Deir al-Balah, while the fourth was killed by Israeli gunfire in Bureij refugee camp. The Israeli military said it struck a "terrorist" in Deir al-Balah and another in Gaza City. Israeli strikes on Gaza take place almost daily despite a US-brokered ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hamas in October last year. More than 1,620 people have been killed in Gaza since then, according to the territory's health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN. Israel says six of its soldiers have been killed in Gaza over the same period. The humanitarian situation in Gaza also remains dire and has recently deteriorated further as a result of heavy rains last weekend that reportedly flooded tens of thousands of tents housing displaced families. The Gaza war was triggered by the Hamas-led attack on southern Israel on 7 October 2023, when about 1,200 people were killed and 251 others were taken hostage. Since then, more than 74,650 people have been killed in Gaza, the health ministry says. - Published2 days ago

news.titleTr: Golda Gıda'dan temettü kararı: 2025 yılı kârı dağıtılmayacak
news.summaryTr: Golda Gıda Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş. (GOLDA), 2025 hesap dönemine ilişkin kâr dağıtım kararını açıkladı. Yönetim Kurulunun kârın dağıtılmaması yönündeki teklifi Genel Kurulda kabul edildi.
news.articleText: Golda Gıda'dan temettü kararı: 2025 yılı kârı dağıtılmayacak - Golda Gıda Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş. (GOLDA), 2025 hesap dönemine ilişkin kâr dağıtım kararını açıkladı. Yönetim Kurulunun kârın dağıtılmaması yönündeki teklifi Genel Kurul'da kabul edildi. Golda Gıda Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş. (GOLDA), 2025 yılı kârının kullanımına ve kâr dağıtımına ilişkin kararını Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) bildirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirket tarafından 12 Kasım 2026 tarihinde yapılan açıklamaya göre, Yönetim Kurulunun 2025 hesap dönemine ait kârın dağıtılmaması yönündeki teklifi Genel Kurul'da kabul edildi. Kararın, şirket esas sözleşmesinin "Kârın Tespiti ve Dağıtımı" başlıklı 20'nci maddesi, ilgili mevzuat ve Kâr Dağıtım Politikası çerçevesinde hazırlandığı belirtildi. GOLDA yatırımcıları için temettü kararı Genel Kurulda kabul edilen kararla birlikte Golda Gıda'nın 2025 hesap dönemine ilişkin kârından pay sahiplerine nakit temettü dağıtılmayacak. Temettü, şirketlerin elde ettikleri dönem kârının bir bölümünü nakit veya bedelsiz pay şeklinde ortaklarına dağıtması anlamına geliyor. Şirketlerin kâr dağıtıp dağıtmama kararı genel kurul onayından geçiyor.

news.titleTr: Türk Telekom'dan 26,1 milyon dolarlık Eurobond alımı
news.summaryTr: Türk Telekom (TTKOM), 2029 vadeli kendi ihraç ettiği Eurobond'lardan 25 milyon dolar nominal değerindeki tahvili geri satın aldı. İşlem kapsamında ödenecek toplam tutar 26,1 milyon doları aştı.
news.articleText: Türk Telekom'dan 26,1 milyon dolarlık Eurobond alımı - Türk Telekom (TTKOM), 2029 vadeli kendi ihraç ettiği Eurobond'lardan 25 milyon dolar nominal değerindeki tahvili geri satın aldı. İşlem kapsamında ödenecek toplam tutar 26,1 milyon doları aştı. Türk Telekom (TTKOM), kendi ihraç ettiği Eurobond'lara yönelik geri alım işlemi gerçekleştirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirketin 12 Kasım 2026 tarihinde Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) yaptığı açıklamaya göre, 2029 vadeli tahvillerden 25 milyon ABD doları nominal değerinde alım yapıldı. XS2820499619 ISIN kodlu Eurobond'lar, 100,975 ABD doları fiyat üzerinden satın alındı. Toplam ödeme 26,1 milyon dolar KAP açıklamasında, söz konusu Eurobond'ların alım maliyetine kupon tahakkukunun da dahil edildiği belirtildi. İşlem kapsamında ödenecek toplam tutarın 26 milyon 145 bin 138,89 ABD doları olduğu bildirildi. Eurobond geri alımı, şirketlerin daha önce ihraç ettikleri ve piyasada işlem gören borçlanma araçlarını vadesinden önce yeniden satın alması anlamına geliyor. Bu işlemler şirketlerin borç yönetimi ve finansman stratejilerinin bir parçası olarak gerçekleştirilebiliyor.

news.titleTr: Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan COP31'de açıkladı: Türkiye'nin enerji hedefinde yeni adım
news.summaryTr: Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, COP31 İş Forumu'nda önemli açıklamalarda bulundu.
news.articleText: Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan COP31'de açıkladı: Türkiye'nin enerji hedefinde yeni adım - Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan, COP31 İş Forumu'nda Türkiye'nin yeşil dönüşüm hedeflerine ilişkin önemli mesajlar verdi. - Türkiye'nin 2053 net sıfır emisyon hedefini yineleyen Erdoğan, "Nükleer güç santrallerimizin sayısını artıracağız" dedi. Erdoğan, iş dünyasına da iklim mücadelesinde daha fazla sorumluluk üstlenme çağrısı yaptı. Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, COP31 İş Forumu'nda önemli açıklamalarda bulundu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Erdoğan'ın açıklamalarından satır başları şöyle: "Dünya iş çevrelerinin kıymetli temsilcileri, saygıdeğer bakanlar, değerli misafirler. Sizleri en kalbi duygularımla, saygıyla, sevgiyle selamlıyorum. COP31 Liderler Zirvesi vesilesiyle sizlerle Antalya'da bir araya gelmekten büyük bir memnuniyet duyuyorum. Tarihin, tabiatın, tarımın ve turizmin buluşma noktası güzel Antalya'mıza hepiniz hoş geldiniz, sefalar getirdiniz. 96 lideri ülkemizde ağırladık Siyasetçiler, sivil toplum temsilcileri, çevre savunucuları ve iş dünyası olarak müşterek evimiz olan yeryüzünün geleceğine sahip çıkmak için Antalya'da toplanmış bulunuyoruz. Öncelikle Antalya'ya gelerek dünyamızı daha yaşanabilir bir yer haline getirme çabalarımıza verdiğiniz destek için her birinize teşekkür ediyorum. Türkiye Cumhuriyeti tarihinin en kapsamlı uluslararası organizasyonuna ev sahipliği yapmanın bahtiyarlığını yaşıyoruz. 9 Kasım'da başlayan COP31'de dün ve bugün yapılan Liderler Zirvesi'nde farklı unvanlarda 96 lideri ülkemizde ağırladık. 20 Kasım'a kadar devam edecek konferansa dünyanın dört bir yanından yaklaşık yüz bin kişinin katılımını bekliyoruz. Ön kayıt rakamlarına göre en yüksek katılımlı COP olmaya adayız. Yeşil ve mavi bölgelerden oluşan 1 milyon 100 bin metrekarelik alanımız şimdiye kadarki en büyük konferans alanları arasındadır. Bütün bu rakamlar konferansa verdiğimiz önemin yanı sıra ülkemizin çok taraflı diplomasisinin merkezlerinden biri haline geldiğini göstermektedir. Kıymetli dostlar, hepinizin bildiği üzere iklim krizinin ulaştığı ürkütücü boyutlar küresel ölçekte kararlı adımlar atılmasını zorunlu kılıyor. Bu anlayışta COP31'i taahhütlerin somut sonuçlara dönüşmesine imkan verecek bir uygulama konferansı olarak tasarladık. Liderler zirvemizin ilk gününü 'sıfır atık' konusuna ayırdık. Zirvemizin ikinci gününde ise 'dirençli şehirler ve sürdürülebilir çevre' temalarına odaklandık. Türkiye malumunuz 6 Şubat 2023'te asrın deprem felaketiyle sarsılmış bir ülkedir. 11 şehrimizi etkileyen bu felakette 53 binden fazla canımızı kaybettik. 6 Şubat depremlerinin ardından 3 yıldan daha kısa sürede 455 bin konut ve iş yeri inşa ederek deprem bölgemizi yeniden ayağa kaldırdık. Zirvede bu alandaki tecrübelerimizi katılımcılarla paylaşma imkanı bulduk. İklim değişikliğinin ağır etkilerine maruz kalan Afrika ve Pasifik ülkelerinin karşılaştığı zorlukları da gündeme taşıdık. Şunu burada bir kez daha altını çizerek ifade etmek isterim. Küresel karbon bütçesini tüketen gelişmiş ülkeler emisyon azaltımında ve finansmanda daha fazla sorumluluk üstlenmelidir. Gelişmekte olan ülkelerin kalkınma hakkı korunmalı, iklim krizinin bedelini en ağır ödeyen toplumlar güçlü biçimde desteklenmelidir. "Bunun bedelini evlatlarımız ödeyecektir" Ölümüzdeki günlerde müzakere başkanı Avustralya'nın da katkılarıyla belirlediğimiz 10 öncelikli alanda somut ilerleme sağlamayı hedefliyoruz. Ancak sizler de takdir edersiniz ki böyle evrensel bir mücadelede salt hükümetlerin gayretiyle başarıya ulaşılamaz. İş dünyasının da elini taşın altına koyarak sorumluluk üstlenmesi gerekir. Şurası bir gerçek ki bugün karşılaştığımız zorluklarda geçmişte çevreyi hoyratça kirletmenin, kaynakları hoyratça sömürmenin büyük payı vardır. 50 sene, 100 sene önce yapılan yanlışlar şimdi tek tek karşımıza çıkıyor. Eğer bugün biz de aynı hataları tekrarlar, ekolojiyi ekonomiye feda edersek bunun bedelini evlatlarımız ödeyecektir. Böyle bir yanlışa zaten biz izin vermeyiz. İş çevrelerimizin buna müsaade etmeyeceğine inanıyorum. Kıymetli misafirler, Türkiye olarak 2053 hedefimizi net sıfır emisyon olarak ilan ettik. Bu doğrultuda yeşil kalkınma yolculuğumuzu kararlılıkla sürdürüyoruz. Erdoğan, iş dünyasına da iklim mücadelesinde daha fazla sorumluluk üstlenme çağrısı yaptı. Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, COP31 İş Forumu'nda önemli açıklamalarda bulundu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Erdoğan'ın açıklamalarından satır başları şöyle: "Dünya iş çevrelerinin kıymetli temsilcileri, saygıdeğer bakanlar, değerli misafirler. Sizleri en kalbi duygularımla, saygıyla, sevgiyle selamlıyorum. COP31 Liderler Zirvesi vesilesiyle sizlerle Antalya'da bir araya gelmekten büyük bir memnuniyet duyuyorum. Tarihin, tabiatın, tarımın ve turizmin buluşma noktası güzel Antalya'mıza hepiniz hoş geldiniz, sefalar getirdiniz. 96 lideri ülkemizde ağırladık Siyasetçiler, sivil toplum temsilcileri, çevre savunucuları ve iş dünyası olarak müşterek evimiz olan yeryüzünün geleceğine sahip çıkmak için Antalya'da toplanmış bulunuyoruz. Öncelikle Antalya'ya gelerek dünyamızı daha yaşanabilir bir yer haline getirme çabalarımıza verdiğiniz destek için her birinize teşekkür ediyorum. Türkiye Cumhuriyeti tarihinin en kapsamlı uluslararası organizasyonuna ev sahipliği yapmanın bahtiyarlığını yaşıyoruz. 9 Kasım'da başlayan COP31'de dün ve bugün yapılan Liderler Zirvesi'nde farklı unvanlarda 96 lideri ülkemizde ağırladık. 20 Kasım'a kadar devam edecek konferansa dünyanın dört bir yanından yaklaşık yüz bin kişinin katılımını bekliyoruz. news.titleTr: What we know as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns over affair allegations
news.summaryTr: The billionaire tech executive has left the company following reports of a second extramarital affair.
news.articleText: What we know as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns over affair allegations - Published One of the AI industry's most important figures has resigned amid allegations that he had extramarital affairs with two women - one a suspected Chinese spy and the other a company executive. Chip-maker Nvidia hired a major law firm earlier this week to investigate CEO Jensen Huang's reported relationship with a woman who was allegedly a Chinese intelligence asset. Now he has resigned after its stocks plummeted on Wednesday following US media reports about a second alleged affair. Huang admitted, external earlier this week to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and he apologised for hurting her and their children. Here is what we know about the affair and why it matters. How was Huang removed? Nvidia's board met on Wednesday evening to decide whether its CEO should remain with the company. It had 11 directors on its board, including Huang. The firm's CEO could be removed with or without cause by a majority vote of directors. But that wasn't in the end needed - the board instead announced Huang had resigned as president, CEO and board member. It thanked him for his "immeasurable contributions" to Nvidia, which it said were "profound". There was no mention of the accusations of adultery. Who will replace him? Nvidia Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO. It is less clear is who will replace Huang on a permanent basis. One possibility is Nvidia co-founder Chris Malachowsky. He has been at the company as long as Huang, and for years led its product engineering work. Huang's children, Spencer and Madison, and son-in-law Nico Caprez also work at Nvidia in senior roles, but they are relatively young and inexperienced. And there is also the option of Ian Buck, who runs high-performance computing at the firm. He developed the technology which allowed graphics cards to be used for other computing tasks, which enabled Nvidia to capitalise on the growth of AI. What we know about Huang's affairs A New York Times report at the weekend revealed Jensen Huang had a close relationship with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who US intelligence officials believed was a spy for Beijing. She had previously been photographed with him on several occasions. The tech giant's board of directors launched an independent external investigation on Sunday following the reports. They earlier said Huang's interactions with the woman were "not unusual or unexpected". Then on Wednesday, the New York Times reported Huang also had an extramarital relationship with an Nvidia executive, Kimberly Powell, who reported directly to him. She did not respond to the BBC's request for comment. Who is Jensen Huang? Born in Taiwan in 1963, Jensen Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the west coast of the US. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. He worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia. Known as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan and once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", he has a reputation as a workaholic with incredibly high standards for his staff. He has an estimated fortune of $155bn (£115bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on the Jensen Huang, told the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. The Nvidia co-founder has a famously close relationship with US President Donald Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Huang. Who is Alice Huang? US officials believed Alice Huang had been recruited to spy by China's top intelligence agency, the New York Times reported, external. She was a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed between March and November 2023. Her company had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China, which the firm said had been investigated and debunked. However, Megaspeed is under investigation by the Singaporean government regarding previous allegations that the company was circumventing US sanctions on the export of Nvidia's high-end chips. The BBC has contacted Megaspeed for comment. It remains unclear what, if any, intelligence Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly gathered and passed to Beijing. When the BBC asked Nvidia if the company was aware of intelligence concerns, the company said it was not. China has rejected the spying allegations as "entirely groundless". - Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy - Published2 days ago - Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond - Published2 days ago - Nvidia hires major New York law firm to investigate Jensen Huang affair - Published1 day ago Why does it matter? Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world - so the slump in its value which followed Huang's resignation hits investors large and small. The firm is also at the heart of US and China's AI race, which is why the billionaire's affair has sparked national security fears among US lawmakers. Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the concern is if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities. The US advantage is in large part because of companies like Nvidia, working with producers such as the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips. Since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. This means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the world's most lucrative market, with Huang once saying Nvidia's share of the Chinese market had gone from around 95% to effectively zero. He has engaged in shuttle diplomacy between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way. The revelations may explain why Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China. What investigations are now under way? After news broke out about the first affair, Nvidia launched an independent investigation and hired New York law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. It will be led by Joon Kim, a former US Attorney for New York's Southern District who is now a litigation partner at the law firm. US President Donald Trump said the FBI was investigating the scandal, adding that Huang told him he had been unaware the woman he was with was a spy. Huang has also been asked to appear for a joint closed-door briefing for several Congressional committees on 18 November, but has yet to say he will comply. What is Nvidia and how important is it? Founded by Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993, the company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for gaming. Eventually it changed focus to AI, a field it now dominates. Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did, effectively building the infrastructure from scratch. He bet on AI at a time when "there were no customers for the stuff he was building", Witt told the BBC. Every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure like Amazon, Google and Microsoft now use Nvidia chips. Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world. Who is Jensen Huang's wife? Jensen Huang met his future wife Lori Mills at Oregon State University while studying electrical engineering in the early 1980s. The pair were lab partners. They married in 1985 and have two children, Madison and Spencer. Earlier this week, Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. In 2007, the couple founded the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation. The charitable fund has seen its assets surge in recent years, driven by the soaring value of Nvidia shares, and is estimated to be worth more than $9bn. Its donations include tens of millions of dollars to engineering programmes at Oregon State and Stanford University. Witt told the BBC that Jensen Huang has gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, adding: "That's very important to him." "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," he added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. "But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad." Additional reporting by Tom McArthur in London, Ayeshea Perera and Tessa Wong in Singapore and Helen Davidson in Sydney - Published21 September

When the BBC asked Nvidia if the company was aware of intelligence concerns, the company said it was not. China has rejected the spying allegations as "entirely groundless". - Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy - Published2 days ago - Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond - Published2 days ago - Nvidia hires major New York law firm to investigate Jensen Huang affair - Published1 day ago Why does it matter? Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world - so the slump in its value which followed Huang's resignation hits investors large and small. The firm is also at the heart of US and China's AI race, which is why the billionaire's affair has sparked national security fears among US lawmakers. Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the concern is if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities. The US advantage is in large part because of companies like Nvidia, working with producers such as the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips. Since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. This means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the world's most lucrative market, with Huang once saying Nvidia's share of the Chinese market had gone from around 95% to effectively zero. He has engaged in shuttle diplomacy between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way. The revelations may explain why Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China. What investigations are now under way? After news broke out about the first affair, Nvidia launched an independent investigation and hired New York law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. It will be led by Joon Kim, a former US Attorney for New York's Southern District who is now a litigation partner at the law firm. US President Donald Trump said the FBI was investigating the scandal, adding that Huang told him he had been unaware the woman he was with was a spy. Huang has also been asked to appear for a joint closed-door briefing for several Congressional committees on 18 November, but has yet to say he will comply. What is Nvidia and how important is it? Founded by Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993, the company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for gaming. Eventually it changed focus to AI, a field it now dominates. Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did, effectively building the infrastructure from scratch. He bet on AI at a time when "there were no customers for the stuff he was building", Witt told the BBC. Every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure like Amazon, Google and Microsoft now use Nvidia chips. Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world. Who is Jensen Huang's wife? Jensen Huang met his future wife Lori Mills at Oregon State University while studying electrical engineering in the early 1980s. The pair were lab partners. They married in 1985 and have two children, Madison and Spencer. Earlier this week, Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. In 2007, the couple founded the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation. The charitable fund has seen its assets surge in recent years, driven by the soaring value of Nvidia shares, and is estimated to be worth more than $9bn. Its donations include tens of millions of dollars to engineering programmes at Oregon State and Stanford University. Witt told the BBC that Jensen Huang has gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, adding: "That's very important to him." "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," he added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. "But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad." news.titleTr: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says
news.summaryTr: Medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies, MSF warns
news.articleText: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says - Published Hundreds of millions of dollars meant to help tackle Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo are not reaching the intended recipients, a medical charity has warned. A report from Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) said that while the outbreak remained "out of control", front-line workers were going unpaid, lacked proper training and were struggling with shortages of essential supplies. It added that in some cases ambulances had run out of fuel. More than 5,400 people have died and 11,000 infected with Ebola in DR Congo since the outbreak was declared in May. This makes it the second-most deadly outbreak of the disease ever recorded. MSF has urged the Congolese government and UN agencies to "strengthen oversight and accountability" to ensure money already disbursed is effectively utilised. This means "ensuring response personnel are properly trained, paid, equipped, and supported, and directing resources towards areas where needs are greatest", it said. The BBC has asked the Congolese government for comment. MSF's warning adds to concerns raised by Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) last month, when it said that $700m (£527m) out of $962m disbursed to organisations implementing Ebola response was unaccounted for. At the time, Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya said it was too early to describe it as embezzlement, characterising the issue as a major transparency and financial reporting failure. The Congolese health minister echoed these concerns, saying that aid agencies were required to provide details of their work so the ministry could provide oversight but that only 22% had done so. "Our requirement is clear: transparency must be total. The response relies on a single plan, a single budget, and a single coordination," Health Minister Samuel-Roger Kamba said on X., external - What is Ebola and why is stopping the latest outbreak so difficult? - Published15 September In its report, external, the charity said: "Despite the vast amounts of money provided for the response, many frontline responders are left trying to contain the outbreak with empty hands and empty pockets." It also mentioned Ebola monitoring "surveillance teams that exist on paper but are nowhere to be seen on the ground". "Our teams are often left speechless by the dysfunctions they witness in many areas. Six months into the response, this situation is simply unacceptable," said MSF president Javid Abdelmoneim. One important way of stopping Ebola from spreading is contact tracing - finding all those people who had come into contact with an infected person and putting them into isolation. "Despite the resources officially allocated to this critical activity, surveillance remains deeply problematic," MSF said, adding that two-thirds of deaths were occurring in communities not treatment centres. According to British epidemiologist Neil Ferguson, more than half of the cases are going undetected, meaning the outbreak is likely to last another year, reports the Reuters news agency. MSF also raised concerns over "excessive concentration" of efforts in certain areas at the expense of other areas where needs were more urgent. It said the response was "too slow" in North Kivu province while Haut-Uélé remained "dramatically overlooked". In both provinces, MSF observed that teams were "inadequately resourced to respond effectively" with health facilities lacking essential items such as water, chlorine or triage systems. "This has turned some facilities into new centres of transmission, rather than places of care that contribute to containing the disease," MSF said. The epicentre of the outbreak is in eastern DR Congo, which has been wracked by conflict for many decades, with some affected areas under rebel control. There are very few good roads in the area, making it very hard to travel around. On Thursday, the UN and government warned that the areas worst affected by Ebola were also suffering from a severe food crisis, with almost 10 million in the region in dire need. The latest outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo species of the virus, has spread beyond DR Congo borders, with cases reported in Kenya, Uganda and Nigeria. On Wednesday, the last person infected with Ebola in Kenya was discharged, marking a major milestone in efforts to contain the disease in the East African nation. The Bundibugyo species is relatively rare and has no approved vaccine or treatment - though trials are under way. news.titleTr: Who is Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress - and who could take over permanently?
news.summaryTr: Chief financial officer Colette Kress in in charge of Nvidia for now, but several others are in the frame as potential successors.
news.articleText: Who is Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress - and who could take over permanently? - Published Nvidia is now facing a scenario few would have considered until very recently - a future without Jensen Huang. The influential co-founder of the AI chip-making giant resigned on Thursday over reports of extramarital affairs, one of which was with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. Chief financial officer Colette Kress is in charge, for now, as the tech giant faces one of its biggest challenges - finding the right person to permanently lead the business that Huang helped create more than three decades ago and turned into one of the world's most valuable companies. We take a look at which candidates have emerged as potential successors. The finance chief Colette Kress has been an industry veteran for more than 30 years, having previously held high positions at tech firms like Cisco and Microsoft. Kress, who also serves as Nvidia's executive vice-president, has seen the firm's transformation from making chips for video games in the early 1990s to becoming an AI semiconductor powerhouse. She has "fronted every earnings call" alongside Huang and is a "familiar and trusted voice for the market at a time when it badly needs one," said Josh Gilbert, an analyst at investment firm eToro. But doing the job permanently could be a different story, said Gilbert, as the firm, known for its edge in technology, could want an engineer in the chair. The co-founder and the engineer Another option is Chris Malachowsky, who founded Nvidia alongside Huang and Curtis Priem, and is the only executive that shares the same level of seniority. Malachowsky has played a key part in developing the company's computing technology. Ian Buck, who oversees Nvidia's high-performance computing business, has also emerged as a potential candidate if the company is keen to put an engineer in the top job. Buck was among the early pioneers who helped popularise the use of graphic processors beyond gaming applications. "He could protect Nvidia's technological edge, but his ability to manage the wider commercial relationships and geopolitical challenges would face scrutiny," said Charu Chanana, investment strategist at investment bank Saxo. Today, Nvidia's leading processors are widely regarded as the gold standard for AI development. Huang's children also work at Nvidia in executive positions but are relatively young and inexperienced. Apple and Arm's top brass Nvidia is likely to favour an internal appointment initially but could look externally for a more permanent replacement, said Jun Bei Liu, founder and lead portfolio manager at Ten Cap. Several names of tech entrepreneurs outside of Nvidia have been floated by experts. Liu said Apple's former chief executive, Tim Cook, could be a possible choice as someone familiar with managing global supply chains, though she questioned whether he would be willing to leave the iPhone maker, where he is the chair. Liu and Chanana also suggested Rene Haas, chief executive of Arm Holdings, the UK chipmaking giant. Nvidia's processors are made with the help of chipmakers around the world, including Taiwan's TSMC and South Korea's SK Hynix and Samsung. Haas is familiar with leading a publicly-listed company and would bring semiconductor experience, though Nvidia's business model is considerably different from Arm's, said Chanana. "The challenge is finding someone who can combine Jensen's technical understanding, strategic vision and relationships across the global technology industry," Liu said. What now for Nvidia? Ten Cap's Liu had believed it was just a matter of time before Huang would step down as Nvidia's chief executive. "The issue is no longer simply about personal conduct," she said. "It is about corporate governance, national security concerns and maintaining confidence in the leadership of one of the world's most strategically important companies." Several major investment firms have downgraded their forecasts for the chip giant - a rare shift given investors' longstanding optimism about the company. An early indication came as markets opened in New York shortly after Huang's resignation was announced. Nvidia shares opened down more than 13%, wiping more than half a trillion dollars off the firm's share market value. Stacy Rasgon, senior analyst in US semiconductors at Bernstein Research, wrote in a note to investors that "our gut tells us we probably haven't fully probed the depths of what might be found here". Rasgon halved Bernstein's share price target for Nvidia and said: "We've had enough and prefer to watch from the sidelines." Ray Wang, chief executive of Constellation Research, said the crisis isn't so much an issue for the wider AI industry but rather one for Nvidia itself which has to consider if the person it appoints as its chief executive has the same appeal as Huang. "That's really what the issue is, because a lot of these partnerships and investments have been made because of the trust with with Jensen," he said. news.titleTr: Poundland gets more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue
news.summaryTr: A deadline to secure a buyer was set to expire at midnight, but the retailer now has an extra 10 days to find a buyer.
news.articleText: Poundland gets more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue - Published Poundland has avoided immediate collapse after a deadline was extended to find a rescue deal. A deadline to secure a buyer for the retail chain was set to expire at midnight, but a court has given Poundland an extra 10 days to find a buyer. The discount chain, which has 11,000 employees, has been edging towards administration after being blocked by owners Gordon Brothers from accessing cash in its bank accounts. A committee of MPs questioned Gordon Brothers following accusations that the investment firm hoped to profit from selling off Poundland's 600 shops and stock piecemeal. Gordon Brothers - which bought the chain for just £1 last year - is accused of forcing that outcome by restricting Poundland's access to available cash needed to restock shops, and pay wages and rent, ahead of the crucial Christmas trading period. The investment firm, which specialises in buying and restructuring distressed companies, has denied the claims. However, pressure remains on Poundland's owners after a takeover bid was rejected. The decision prompted calls for answers from politicians, including Prime Minister Andy Burnham. About £50m had been frozen by Gordon Brothers, the BBC understands, meaning Poundland bosses were unable to restock shelves across its 600 shops. The BBC understands that Gordon Brothers agreed to release a further £11m today from Poundland's accounts, on top of £10m announced earlier, as the firm seeks to find a new buyer. Gordon Brothers said it was in talks with three parties for a sale of the whole business, and it had received "several offers from established high street retailers for significant parts of the business". 'Do the right thing' Following the meeting between MPs on the business and trade committee and representatives of Gordon Brothers, chairman Liam Byrne told the BBC that he was "deeply concerned" and described the firm's behaviour as "much like a wolf on Wall Street, on the British High Street". "They refused to prioritise protecting jobs and stores over and above their own financial returns," he said. "It's clear that they've taken millions out of Poundland at a time when they themselves said the business was on a knife edge." Byrne said the committee's message to Gordon Brothers was to ensure Poundland had "access to the funds that it needs to trade at what should be one of the busiest periods in the year". He urged Gordon Brothers to "do what is right to save jobs and stores and do that now". "It's a good business, it's a much-loved business and, particularly in the middle of the cost of living crisis, communities up and down the country rely on access to the kind of stores that it operates," Byrne added. Views on Poundland performance differ Views on the chain's performance differ between those running operations and the owners. Poundland boss Williams told staff last week that like-for-like sales, which exclude new store openings, were up 11.4%. The sales period included Halloween, but Williams said this was £1.5m ahead of budget. He added that the business made a profit of £18.1m in the year to September, which was a "strong recovery" from the previous year when there were losses of £68m. However, Gordon Brothers has painted a different picture, saying the chain remains "challenged and vulnerable to any potential downturn in future trading". It has argued that the best way of securing jobs may be to split up the business and sell chunks of its 600 sites to other retailers. There has been interest from the likes of Poundstretcher, Tesco and B&M in picking up Poundland shops, which could mean continuing employment for workers at those sites. The main issue is whether a piecemeal sale would protect more jobs than a buyer willing to keep Poundland as a national chain. Get in touch Are you affected by issues discussed in this story?
