news.titleTr: Before Scott Colom, these two men were the last black US senators from Mississippi
news.summaryTr: The Democratic candidate won in a southern state that had not seated a black senator since 1874.
news.articleText: Before Scott Colom, these two men were the last black US senators from Mississippi - Published After winning a close race in Mississippi, Democrat Scott Colom will become the state's first black US senator for more than 150 years, and the third in history. It is a historic result in the deeply conservative southern state that last sent a Democrat to the US Senate in 1982, and had not seated a black senator since 1875. Colom follows Hiram Revels, who became the first black person ever to serve in the chamber when he was seated from 1870 to 1871, and Blanche Bruce, whose term ran from 1875 to 1881. Revels and Bruce were both members of the Republican Party. Revels was chosen as Mississippi's first senator after the Civil War, serving for just over a year and campaigning strongly for racial equality. A few years later, Bruce, who was born into slavery, became the first black person to serve a full term in the US Senate. He remained in Washington after leaving the chamber and held a role in the Treasury. Both terms came before the repressive Jim Crow laws began to enforce racial segregation across Mississippi and other southern US states. A significant factor in Colom's victory was his success in mobilising young people and the state's large black population, who are expected to have turned out in high numbers. In a victory speech, Colom referenced how Revels, who was a minister and served as a chaplain during the Civil War, gained support for his Senate campaign through his words. "That's an example of the power of prayer, and through our history, there are so many people that lifted this state up through the power of prayer in very dark times," Colom said. Prior to the result being called, the BBC spoke to students at Jackson State University, a historically black college in Mississippi. Many of them had voted for the first time and backed Colom. "I really feel like a change is what we need," 18-year-old Jamyria Dunn said. "I've had some amazing days in my life," she continued, "but seeing Mississippi, this state in particular, turn blue, would really bring a light to my heart that people just would not understand."

news.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, exits board; shares plunge
news.summary: Colette Kress will remain Nvidia’s chief financial officer while serving as interim CEO as the board searches for a permanent successor.

news.titleTr: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, exits board; shares plunge
news.summaryTr: Colette Kress will remain Nvidia’s chief financial officer while serving as interim CEO as the board searches for a permanent successor.
news.articleText: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, exits board; shares plunge Colette Kress will remain Nvidia’s chief financial officer while serving as interim CEO as the board searches for a permanent successor. Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as president and CEO and stepped down from the company’s board on Thursday, effective immediately. The board named Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress interim CEO. Kress will retain her role as CFO while Nvidia’s board considers internal and external candidates for the permanent CEO role. The board also appointed Harvey C. Jones its first chair and said it expects Nvidia’s operations to proceed without interruption. Nvidia shares fell more than 13% shortly after the US market opened on Thursday, trading at $151.00 as of 2:31 p.m. UTC, according to Yahoo Finance. Bitcoin (BTC) fell alongside Nvidia shares, dropping as much as 3.5% to a multimonth low. The shares later pared losses to trade at $165 at 4:24 p.m. UTC, down 5% on the day. The stock was down more than 26% over the previous month. Kress has served as Nvidia’s CFO since September 2013 and previously held finance positions at Cisco and Microsoft. Nvidia is scheduled to report its fiscal 2027 third-quarter financial results on Nov. 17. Huang’s resignation follows foreign intelligence investigation Huang’s departure comes just four days after Nvidia’s board announced an independent investigation amid reports that the company’s co-founder had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. The board said it had no reason to believe US national security or Nvidia’s confidential information had been compromised, but would examine all available information. In a separate message to employees that day, Huang acknowledged an extramarital affair and apologized to his family and colleagues. He also pledged to cooperate with the investigation. The Associated Press identified the woman involved in the affair as Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed. The New York Times reported that US intelligence agencies had concluded she was passing information to Beijing. China has denied targeting Huang. On Tuesday, Nvidia’s independent directors retained former acting US Attorney Joon H. Kim and law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to conduct the inquiry. On Wednesday, reports said Nvidia’s board was preparing to remove Huang as CEO. Nvidia’s rise to $5.5 trillion under Huang Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and served as its CEO for more than 33 years, overseeing its transformation from a graphics-chip maker into a leading supplier of AI processors. His departure marks the first CEO transition in the company’s history. Nvidia’s market capitalization surged from approximately $57.5 billion at the end of 2016 to a peak of $5.5 trillion on Sept. 1, 2026, a nearly 96-fold increase, according to data from Stock Analysis. Amid Nvidia’s sell-off, Huang’s estimated net worth fell to $140.6 billion as of 3:42 p.m. UTC Thursday from $162.2 billion on Nov. 9. Congressional scrutiny continues after resignation House lawmakers still want to question Jensen Huang about his contacts with Alice Huang and Nvidia’s safeguards against foreign espionage, Rep. John Moolenaar said Thursday. “We are in discussions with him right now on a date to come and meet with us,” Moolenaar told reporters, according to Politico. Moolenaar, who chairs the House Select Committee on China, and fellow committee chairs Rick Crawford and Brian Mast first requested a closed-door briefing in a Nov. 4 letter. They cited concerns about Beijing’s access to sensitive US technology and information and asked Huang to confirm by Nov. 11 whether he could attend on Nov. 18 or to propose another date. Moolenaar said the lawmakers were prepared to subpoena Huang if they could not agree on a date. He also wants to determine whether Chinese intelligence gained access to sensitive information and examine Huang’s lobbying to ease US restrictions on advanced chip exports to China. Rep. Gregory Meeks, the top Democrat on the House Foreign Affairs Committee, said he was considering forming a subcommittee to investigate the matter when the new Congress convenes in January. news.title: Eight killed in Colombian air strike targeting Gulf Clan gang
news.summary: A suspected gang leader considered a "priority target" was among those killed, the Colombian president says.

news.titleTr: Eight killed in Colombian air strike targeting Gulf Clan gang
news.summaryTr: A suspected gang leader considered a "priority target" was among those killed, the Colombian president says.
news.articleText: Eight killed in Colombian air strike targeting Gulf Clan gang - Published A senior leader of Colombia's largest criminal gang, the Gulf Clan, is among eight people killed in an air strike carried out by the country's armed forces, according to President Abelardo de la Espriella. De la Espriella said he had personally authorised the bombing targeting the Gulf Clan in the province of Antioquia, in north-west Colombia. He added that Haminton Mosquera, whom he described as a senior member of the crime gang and one of 10 "priority targets" for Colombia's security forces, had been "brought down". De la Espriella was elected in June after campaigning on a promise to crack down on Colombia's powerful criminal gangs, including by launching air strikes. In a post on X, external, he said that Mosquera was suspected of having ordered attacks against the security forces, including the murder of a police officer in the municipality of Tarazá last year. The Gulf Clan has been engaging in criminal activities for decades, mainly trafficking cocaine from Colombia to destinations in the US and Europe but also illegal mining and people smuggling. The US added it to its list of Foreign Terrorist Organisations (FTOs) last year. In his post, President de la Espriella said that "the offensive won't stop" and vowed to regain control of areas currently controlled by criminal organisations such as the Gulf Clan. While his offensive against criminal gangs has been welcomed by many living in areas where extortion and gang violence are rampant, de la Espriella has faced criticism for the way he has made some of his announcements on security. Less than a month after taking office, he published a video showing him walking among 23 body bags containing the remains of 23 people killed in an air strike on a suspected guerrilla camp. On Wednesday, he shared a photo, external in which he can be seen writing his campaign slogan, "Welcome to the miracle homeland" on a bomb. He has also defended his decision to wear an army uniform at a recent event in Cúcuta at which he confronted a detainee suspected of being a Farc rebel. "What did you make of the bomb I sent you, signed by me?," the president can be heard asking the man. He later told journalists that he wore the uniform because "I am a soldier of the homeland. That's why I dress like a soldier, because I came to serve Colombia. Because I honour the heroes, police officers and military." Additional reporting by BBC Monitoring's Luis Fajardo. - Published9 September

news.summaryTr: Bit Digital’s $27 million third-quarter revenue came in 16% below analyst consensus estimates, marking an over $5 million shortfall.
news.articleText: Bit Digital stock falls 5% in pre-market after Q3 revenue miss Bit Digital’s $27 million third-quarter revenue came in 16% below analyst consensus estimates, marking an over $5 million shortfall. Shares in Nasdaq-listed Bit Digital fell 9.3% in premarket trading on Thursday after the Ethereum treasury and AI infrastructure company reported third-quarter revenue below analysts’ estimates. Bit Digital reported $27.1 million in revenue, down 11% from $30.5 million a year earlier. Net income attributable to shareholders was $28.5 million, or 8 cents per diluted share, according to its Thursday SEC filing. The company’s revenue came in nearly 16% below analyst consensus estimates of about $32.2 million, marking a $5.1 million shortfall, according to Yahoo Finance. Bit Digital reported $1 million in Ether (ETH) staking revenue, down about 66% from $2.9 million a year ago. The company reported holdings equivalent to about 163,726 ETH, worth $439.4 million as of Sept. 30. Its Bitcoin mining revenue fell to $2 million from $7.4 million a year earlier. Bit Digital said that the decline in mining revenue was “consistent with the continued winddown of the business.” The company revealed it pivoted its corporate treasury strategy from Bitcoin to Ether in July 2025. Related: Bit Digital buys $20M worth of Ethereum, expands treasury to 158K ETH

news.summary: Thailand’s SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own.

news.titleTr: Thailand proposes $148K daily cap on stablecoin deposits and withdrawals
news.summaryTr: Thailand’s SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own.
news.articleText: Thailand proposes $148K daily cap on stablecoin deposits and withdrawals Thailand’s SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own. Thailand’s securities regulator has proposed capping daily stablecoin deposits and withdrawals at 5 million baht ($148,000) each per customer at regulated crypto operators. The limit would apply separately to deposits and withdrawals at each operator, Thailand’s Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) said in a Thursday announcement. The regulator said the rules aim to curb money laundering, cybercrime and attempts to bypass cross-border money transfer rules. The draft would bar stablecoin transfers to and from third-party wallets. Operators would have to verify that customers own the accounts or wallets they use for deposits and withdrawals. Operators would have to comply with the Travel Rule, which requires crypto service providers to collect and share information about transfers, and use blockchain analytics to identify wallets linked to suspicious activity. The draft would require crypto exchanges to name their market makers and identify the assets for which they provide liquidity. Crypto brokers would be barred from using liquidity providers for stablecoin-baht pairs. Certain off-platform trades would be subject to a 3 million baht minimum. The draft follows a September consultation in which the SEC proposed stablecoin transfer limits and tighter oversight of crypto operators. Related: Thailand to block Bitget in December over unlicensed crypto trading

news.title: Crypto hack losses equal 57 cents per $1 earned onchain: Ark’s Valente
news.summary: Crypto hackers stole $8.7 billion so far in 2026, surpassing the projected annual onchain revenue generated across the industry, according to ARK’s research director.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Crypto hack losses equal 57 cents per $1 earned onchain: Ark’s Valente
news.summaryTr: Crypto hackers stole $8.7 billion so far in 2026, surpassing the projected annual onchain revenue generated across the industry, according to ARK’s research director.
news.articleText: Crypto hack losses equal 57 cents per $1 earned onchain: Ark’s Valente Crypto hackers stole $8.7 billion so far in 2026, surpassing the projected annual onchain revenue generated across the industry, according to ARK’s research director. Hackers stole 57 cents for every $1 earned onchain by blockchain protocols since 2017, according to Lorenzo Valente, director of digital asset research at ARK Investment Management. “Security is the bottleneck,” wrote Valente in a Thursday X post, sharing a chart showing that $8.7 billion lost to crypto hacks year to date had already surpassed the $5.6 billion in estimated annual onchain revenue for 2026. Since 2017, the crypto industry has lost about $26.9 billion to hacks and earned $47 billion in total onchain revenue, he added. The recent $6.3 billion stolen in the Binance hack alone exceeded Valente’s estimate for full-year 2026 onchain revenue. Value lost to hacks is on track to exceed onchain revenue by year-end for the first time since 2020. The crypto industry saw a string of high-value hacks this year, including September’s $387 million Bitget hack and the $320 million Liquid Network exploit, as well as April’s $295 million Drift Protocol exploit. The mounting security exploits are weighing on the institutional appetite for DeFi. In an April research note, JPMorgan analysts identified bridge security as a long-standing challenge for the industry. Total value locked in decentralized finance (DeFi) has fallen nearly 10% since the Binance exploit, from $85.9 billion on Oct. 29 to $77.4 billion on Thursday, according to DefiLlama. Related: Binance warns iOS flaw could expose crypto wallet keys

news.summary: L1 blockchains Zilliqa, Gnosis and Ronin join the Ethereum ecosystem as the costs of going it alone grow, and the security and liquidity advantages become too hard to resist.

news.titleTr: Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum
news.summaryTr: L1 blockchains Zilliqa, Gnosis and Ronin join the Ethereum ecosystem as the costs of going it alone grow, and the security and liquidity advantages become too hard to resist.
news.articleText: Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum L1 blockchains Zilliqa, Gnosis and Ronin join the Ethereum ecosystem as the costs of going it alone grow, and the security and liquidity advantages become too hard to resist. Running an independent blockchain has always come with a particular promise: control. A standalone Layer 1 architecture allows projects to be the masters of their own destiny, set the rules of consensus, maintain their own validators and build infrastructure around their users, without relying on any other network. But with great power comes great responsibility — and considerable expense. Blockchains need enough users, developers and economic activity to support the infrastructure that secures them. For some smaller networks, keeping an entire ecosystem afloat no longer makes economic sense. Zilliqa is the latest project to confront that reality, announcing plans last week to move away from its L1 architecture and become an Ethereum-based Layer 2 (L2) instead: “We know it’s not great. For nine years we built and ran our own Layer 1. It hasn’t worked.” “Usage never reached what a standalone chain needs,” the post explained. “Funding and liquidity for standalone L1s dried up. The recent hacks showed how much it takes to secure a chain alone. The data is onchain for everyone to see.” Zilliqa is not alone. Blockchain ecosystem Gnosis (which has always been Ethereum-adjacent) is also working to transition Gnosis Chain into an Ethereum-based network through its Ethereum Economic Zone (EEZ) initiative. Its RollupX test network intends to show how participating chains can share Ethereum settlement and synchronous composability as native rollups. Gaming-focused Ronin blockchain also completed its move back to Ethereum as an L2 in May. With interest in alt L1s drying up along with the funding, will we start to see more and more chains consolidating in the Ethereum ecosystem? The cost of going it alone Independent L1s generally have to keep several core functions going, including execution, consensus, data availability and settlement. They must also fund the token incentives used to secure their networks through staking. Related: What are native rollups? Full guide to Ethereum’s latest innovation “It comes down to a chain’s profitability,” Max Shannon, senior research analyst at Bitwise, tells Magazine. ZIL becomes a Layer 2 on Ethereum. Source: Zilliqa “L2s only need to maintain execution and do not necessarily need a token, which makes them a more attractive financial and operational proposition,” he says. Shannon says the top ten largest projects are more financially sustainable. Coinbase and Robinhood’s L2 networks generated $48 million and $52 million in fees respectively over the last 365 days, with margins above 90%. The next eight largest chains each generated more than $1 million annually. From 11th place onward, however, annual fees collectively amounted to less than $1 million. So a network may have ambitious technology and a dedicated community, but those things don’t necessarily pay the bills. Ethereum is often criticized for giving away too much of its revenue to L2s, but that’s precisely what makes it attractive to set up projects there. But just becoming an Ethereum L2 doesn’t automatically make a network profitable however. Shannon points to Optimism, Katana and Linea as examples of networks whose expenses outweigh their fee revenue. Projects like Blast have already been forced to shut down. Ethereum as a liquidity ‘black hole’ Gnosis has targeted spring 2027 to complete its transition, which will see it give up its independent validator-based consensus in favor of Ethereum settlement. Gnosis Chain will relaunch as an Ethereum Economic Zone. Source: Gnosis “Two years ago I gave a talk about ‘native Rollups’ that would truly extend Ethereum instead of being isolated chains,” co-founder Martin Köppelmann said, adding that RollupX “even goes beyond what I had imagined back then!” Gnosis’s EEZ initiative aims to enable separate Ethereum-based networks interact synchronously, so a smart contract on one network can call another and use its response within the same transaction, without relying on the usual bridge-and-wait process. That’s a prospect that has some Ethereum supporters particularly bullish, with ETH bull materkel describing the EEZ as a potential “black hole for liquidity,” and saying it could allow participating networks to tap into Ethereum’s total value locked (TVL) and strengthen its position as a liquidity hub. Could network effects, and increased interoperability draw more and more chains into Ethereum’s orbit? Beyond the cost savings It isn’t only the operating cost economics that make sense. Projects can also tap into an established ecosystem of applications and developers rather than building those network effects from scratch. Related: Privacy tools are rising behind institutional adoption, says ZKsync dev Alex Gluchowski, co-founder and chief executive of Matter Labs, the company behind Ethereum L2 ZKsync, says he expects more L1 teams to maintain their own chains while using Ethereum for settlement. “Running an independent L1 means maintaining its security as well as building something people want to use,” Gluchowski tells Magazine. “Sharing Ethereum’s security gives a team more room to focus on its users. I see very few user needs that require an independent L1 rather than an Ethereum-based chain.” But Gluchowski says sovereignty and Ethereum integration are not mutually exclusive, since chains can retain control over their rules and operations while using Ethereum for shared settlement. Ronin completed migration to Ethereum in May. Source: Ronin And for applications handling sensitive financial information, maintaining a private environment under their own control can be essential, he says. Shared settlement does not have to mean exposing confidential transaction data. The biggest obstacle today is that all the L2s are effectively isolated from each other and from Ethereum. It’s certainly possible to jump between them, but its far from seamless and interoperability is poor. “Fragmentation is already happening,” Gluchowski says, pointing to the difficulty of connecting networks when transactions involve privacy. Interoperability between private environments will become more important as more applications seek to combine confidential activity with access to public blockchain liquidity, he says. Does every chain need Ethereum? Shannon cautions against describing the market as undergoing straightforward consolidation around Ethereum. Some large institutions are launching L2 networks, he says, including Coinbase and Robinhood, but others are still choosing to build independent L1s, like Circle’s Arc, Stripe’s Tempo, or Hyperliquid’s purpose-specific perpetual futures blockchain. “So there is no clear conclusion to the L1 versus L2 debate as yet,” he says. news.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
news.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

items.title: Fed'den 2027 takviminde dikkat çeken değişiklik: Bir toplantıda faiz kararı yok
items.summary: ABD Merkez Bankası (Fed), 26-27 Ekim 2027'deki toplantısında faiz kararı açıklamayacak. Fed yetkilileri bu toplantıda faiz yerine bankanın geniş kapsamlı para politikası stratejisini ele alacak.

items.articleText: Fed'den 2027 takviminde dikkat çeken değişiklik: Bir toplantıda faiz kararı yok - ABD Merkez Bankası (Fed), 26-27 Ekim 2027'deki toplantısında faiz kararı açıklamayacak. - Fed yetkilileri bu toplantıda faiz yerine bankanın geniş kapsamlı para politikası stratejisini ele alacak. ABD Merkez Bankası (Fed), 2027 yılı Federal Açık Piyasa Komitesi (FOMC) toplantı takviminde değişikliğe gitti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Banka, gelecek yıl yapılacak sekiz toplantıdan birinin genel para politikası stratejisine ayrılacağını duyurdu. Fed'in açıklamasına göre FOMC, 2027'de ocak, mart, nisan, haziran, temmuz, eylül, ekim ve kasım aylarında toplanacak. Ancak 26-27 Ekim tarihlerindeki toplantı diğerlerinden farklı olacak. Söz konusu toplantıda geniş kapsamlı para politikası stratejisi konuları tartışılacak. Komite, bu toplantının ardından olağan şekilde faiz kararını açıklamayacak ve politika bildirisi yayımlamayacak. Fed Başkanı Warsh daha önce duyurmuştu Fed Başkanı Kevin Warsh, geçen ayki para politikası toplantısının ardından yaptığı açıklamada, gelecek yıl toplantı takviminde değişikliğe gidileceğini belirtmişti. Warsh, 2027'deki sekiz toplantıdan birinin genel para politikası stratejisine odaklanacağını ve bu toplantıda faiz kararı için oylama yapılmasının ya da politika açıklaması yayımlanmasının öngörülmediğini ifade etmişti. Fed, para politikası stratejisini düzenli aralıklarla gözden geçirerek enflasyon ve istihdam hedeflerine ulaşmak için kullandığı yaklaşımı değerlendiriyor. 2027'deki ekim toplantısının da bu kapsamlı değerlendirmeye ayrılması planlanıyor.

items.title: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group
items.summary: Specialist Thomas Iglesias was given a Joint Service Commendation Medal for the execution of his duties after Wednesday's incident.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group
items.summaryTr: Specialist Thomas Iglesias was given a Joint Service Commendation Medal for the execution of his duties after Wednesday's incident.
items.articleText: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group - Published US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth has awarded a medal to the guard who reprimanded his group at Arlington National Cemetery. A video of a Veterans Day observance event on Wednesday showed Hegseth, his wife, and senior advisers laughing and talking while posing for photos in front of the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier before the guard told them to be quiet. In a statement, the Pentagon later announced that Hegseth had given Specialist Thomas Iglesias a Joint Service Commendation Medal "for the execution of his duties at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier". Photos shared on the defence secretary's X account showed him presenting the medal to Iglesias. He was accompanied by others whom the Pentagon identified as members of the 3rd US Infantry Regiment, known as the Old Guard, which is responsible for holding vigil over the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. "We love soldiers. We love standards. Well done, Specialist. Carry on Patriots," the accompanying text on Hegseth's post reads. In the video, the army sentinel on duty later identified as Iglesias can be seen stepping towards Hegseth's group and shouting: "All visitors will maintain an atmosphere of silence and respect at all times." The Arlington National Cemetery etiquette requests that visitors speak quietly and do not engage in disrespectful or disorderly conduct. The tomb, which is one of the country's most sacred war memorials, marks the final resting place of an unknown soldier who was killed in World War I. Chief Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell later said in a statement: "While commemorating this solemn day, a soldier correctly and respectfully reminded everyone to maintain decorum." "The Secretary and the entire Department have always honoured - and will always honour - the sacrifices our military men and women have made to keep America safe." A service member from the 3rd Infantry Regiment stands watch over the tomb 24 hours a day and has done so since 1948. It is not unusual for them to admonish visitors to the site, according to the BBC's US partner CBS News. They reportedly do so a few times a day. Earlier, President Donald Trump, Vice-President JD Vance and other top officials attended the annual wreath-laying ceremony at the cemetery. During his speech at the ceremony, Trump offered his gratitude to uniformed service members who have fought for the country. He also touted what he sees as his administration's success in the Iran war. "Under this administration, and it was about time, somebody fought back. All of us fought back," he said. "And we won," Trump said of the Iran war. "It's just a question of when we want to end it. We want to make sure we have a total victory, not a 93% victory." Trump also pointed out Hegseth during the ceremony, saying he's done a "fantastic job" as defence secretary. Trump has repeatedly defended Hegseth amid Democratic lawmakers' push to impeach him. On Tuesday, an effort to impeach the defence secretary under accusations that he waged war on Iran without congressional authorisation failed on Capitol Hill. Hegseth has called the impeachment efforts a "farce" and a "stunt". Related topics - Published7 days ago

items.summaryTr: Hazine ve Maliye Bakanı Mehmet Şimşek, Türkiye'nin son 20 yılda petrol ve doğal gaz ithalatına yaklaşık 1 trilyon dolar ödediğini belirterek, gerekli adımlar atılmazsa gelecek 20 yılda da aynı tutarda ödeme yapılabileceği uyarısında bulundu.
items.articleText: COP31'de Şimşek'ten 1 trilyon dolarlık uyarı: Gelecek 20 yıla dikkat! - Hazine ve Maliye Bakanı Mehmet Şimşek, Türkiye'nin son 20 yılda petrol ve doğalgaz ithalatına yaklaşık 1 trilyon dolar ödediğini belirterek, gerekli adımlar atılmazsa gelecek 20 yılda da aynı tutarda ödeme yapılabileceği uyarısında bulundu. Hazine ve Maliye Bakanı Mehmet Şimşek, karbonsuzlaşmanın ülkelerin uluslararası rekabet gücünü doğrudan etkilediğini belirterek, yeşil dönüşümün Türkiye'nin ekonomi programının merkezinde yer aldığını söyledi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Türkiye'nin ev sahipliğinde düzenlenen COP31 kapsamında Türk Eximbank ve İngiltere'nin ihracat finansman kurumu UK Export Finance (UKEF) tarafından gerçekleştirilen İhracat Kredi Kuruluşu Finansman Zirvesi'nde konuşan Şimşek, küresel ekonominin jeopolitik gerilimler ve ticarette parçalanma gibi zorluklarla karşı karşıya olduğunu ifade etti. Dünyanın yeni taahhütlerden çok finansmanı sağlanan, istihdam ve büyüme oluşturan somut projelere ihtiyaç duyduğunu vurgulayan Şimşek, karbonsuzlaşma ve tedarik zincirlerinin yeniden yapılanmasının küresel ekonominin öncelikleri arasında bulunduğunu kaydetti. Türkiye'nin Avrupa'ya ihracatında karbon vurgusu Avrupa Birliği'nin Sınırda Karbon Düzenleme Mekanizması'nın yürürlüğe girdiğini hatırlatan Şimşek, Türkiye ekonomisinin Avrupa değer zincirleriyle yakın bağlantısına dikkati çekti. Türkiye'nin ihracatının yaklaşık yüzde 55'inin Avrupa'ya, yüzde 43'ünün ise Avrupa Birliği ülkelerine yapıldığını belirten Şimşek, karbon salımının azaltılmaması halinde bazı ürünlerin uluslararası pazarlarda rekabetçi şekilde satılamayacağını söyledi. Yeşil dönüşümün yalnızca çevresel bir konu olmadığını vurgulayan Şimşek, bu sürecin verimlilik, rekabet gücü, sanayinin modernizasyonu ve enerji güvenliği açısından da önem taşıdığını ifade etti. "20 yılda 1 trilyon dolar ödedik" Şimşek, Türkiye'nin son 20 yılda petrol ve doğalgaz ithalatı için yaklaşık 1 trilyon dolar harcadığını belirterek, gerekli adımların atılmaması halinde gelecek 20 yılda da benzer bir faturayla karşılaşılabileceğini söyledi. Yeşil dönüşümün enerji ithalat faturasını azaltacağını ve makroekonomik istikrarı güçlendireceğini dile getiren Şimşek, "Bu açıdan, yeşil dönüşüm bizim için tercih değil, zorunluluk." dedi. "Piyasada yeterince sermaye var" Yeşil dönüşüm yatırımları için küresel ve yerel finansman ihtiyacının yüksek olduğunu belirten Şimşek, piyasada yeterli sermaye bulunduğunu ancak yatırımların önündeki temel engelin uygun yatırım ortamının eksikliği olduğunu kaydetti. Gelişmekte olan ülkelerde temiz enerji projelerinin finansmanının gelişmiş ekonomilere kıyasla en az iki kat daha pahalı olabildiğini aktaran Şimşek, bu farkın önemli bölümünün algılanan risklerden kaynaklandığını ifade etti. Çok taraflı kalkınma bankaları, ihracat kredi kuruluşları ve ticari bankaların birlikte hareket etmesinin finansman maliyetlerini düşürebileceğini belirten Şimşek, risk paylaşımıyla özel sermayenin de projelere çekilebileceğini söyledi. İklim finansmanı için üç öneri Türkiye'nin Ulusal Yeşil Finansman Stratejisi ve Eylem Planı ile sürdürülebilir finansmanın çerçevesini oluşturduğunu, İklim Kanunu ile 2053 net sıfır emisyon hedefinin yasal güvenceye kavuştuğunu hatırlatan Şimşek, COP31 kapsamında hayata geçirilen İklim Uygulama Köprüsü (BRIDGE) girişimine de değindi. BRIDGE'in ülkelerin önceliklerini finansmana hazır projelere dönüştürmesine ve bu projeleri yatırımcılarla buluşturmasına yardımcı olacağını belirten Şimşek, üç öneri sundu: Temiz enerji, dayanıklı altyapı ve sürdürülebilir sanayi alanlarında ortak proje portföyü oluşturulması. İhracat kredileri, kalkınma finansmanı ve ticari kredilerin ortak finansman modeliyle bir araya getirilmesi. Ülkelerin ve iş dünyasının projelere ilk aşamadan itibaren dahil edilmesi. Şimşek, iklim ve kalkınma hedeflerinin birlikte ilerlemesi gerektiğini belirterek, yatırımların gelişmekte olan ekonomilerde uygun fiyatlı enerji, güvenilir altyapı, istihdam ve dayanıklılık sağlamasının önemini vurguladı.

CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Türkiye'nin ev sahipliğinde düzenlenen COP31 kapsamında Türk Eximbank ve İngiltere'nin ihracat finansman kurumu UK Export Finance (UKEF) tarafından gerçekleştirilen İhracat Kredi Kuruluşu Finansman Zirvesi'nde konuşan Şimşek, küresel ekonominin jeopolitik gerilimler ve ticarette parçalanma gibi zorluklarla karşı karşıya olduğunu ifade etti. Dünyanın yeni taahhütlerden çok finansmanı sağlanan, istihdam ve büyüme oluşturan somut projelere ihtiyaç duyduğunu vurgulayan Şimşek, karbonsuzlaşma ve tedarik zincirlerinin yeniden yapılanmasının küresel ekonominin öncelikleri arasında bulunduğunu kaydetti. Türkiye'nin Avrupa'ya ihracatında karbon vurgusu Avrupa Birliği'nin Sınırda Karbon Düzenleme Mekanizması'nın yürürlüğe girdiğini hatırlatan Şimşek, Türkiye ekonomisinin Avrupa değer zincirleriyle yakın bağlantısına dikkati çekti. Türkiye'nin ihracatının yaklaşık yüzde 55'inin Avrupa'ya, yüzde 43'ünün ise Avrupa Birliği ülkelerine yapıldığını belirten Şimşek, karbon salımının azaltılmaması halinde bazı ürünlerin uluslararası pazarlarda rekabetçi şekilde satılamayacağını söyledi. Yeşil dönüşümün yalnızca çevresel bir konu olmadığını vurgulayan Şimşek, bu sürecin verimlilik, rekabet gücü, sanayinin modernizasyonu ve enerji güvenliği açısından da önem taşıdığını ifade etti. "20 yılda 1 trilyon dolar ödedik" Şimşek, Türkiye'nin son 20 yılda petrol ve doğalgaz ithalatı için yaklaşık 1 trilyon dolar harcadığını belirterek, gerekli adımların atılmaması halinde gelecek 20 yılda da benzer bir faturayla karşılaşılabileceğini söyledi. Yeşil dönüşümün enerji ithalat faturasını azaltacağını ve makroekonomik istikrarı güçlendireceğini dile getiren Şimşek, "Bu açıdan, yeşil dönüşüm bizim için tercih değil, zorunluluk." dedi. "Piyasada yeterince sermaye var" Yeşil dönüşüm yatırımları için küresel ve yerel finansman ihtiyacının yüksek olduğunu belirten Şimşek, piyasada yeterli sermaye bulunduğunu ancak yatırımların önündeki temel engelin uygun yatırım ortamının eksikliği olduğunu kaydetti. Gelişmekte olan ülkelerde temiz enerji projelerinin finansmanının gelişmiş ekonomilere kıyasla en az iki kat daha pahalı olabildiğini aktaran Şimşek, bu farkın önemli bölümünün algılanan risklerden kaynaklandığını ifade etti. Çok taraflı kalkınma bankaları, ihracat kredi kuruluşları ve ticari bankaların birlikte hareket etmesinin finansman maliyetlerini düşürebileceğini belirten Şimşek, risk paylaşımıyla özel sermayenin de projelere çekilebileceğini söyledi. İklim finansmanı için üç öneri Türkiye'nin Ulusal Yeşil Finansman Stratejisi ve Eylem Planı ile sürdürülebilir finansmanın çerçevesini oluşturduğunu, İklim Kanunu ile 2053 net sıfır emisyon hedefinin yasal güvenceye kavuştuğunu hatırlatan Şimşek, COP31 kapsamında hayata geçirilen İklim Uygulama Köprüsü (BRIDGE) girişimine de değindi. BRIDGE'in ülkelerin önceliklerini finansmana hazır projelere dönüştürmesine ve bu projeleri yatırımcılarla buluşturmasına yardımcı olacağını belirten Şimşek, üç öneri sundu: Temiz enerji, dayanıklı altyapı ve sürdürülebilir sanayi alanlarında ortak proje portföyü oluşturulması. İhracat kredileri, kalkınma finansmanı ve ticari kredilerin ortak finansman modeliyle bir araya getirilmesi. Ülkelerin ve iş dünyasının projelere ilk aşamadan itibaren dahil edilmesi. Şimşek, iklim ve kalkınma hedeflerinin birlikte ilerlemesi gerektiğini belirterek, yatırımların gelişmekte olan ekonomilerde uygun fiyatlı enerji, güvenilir altyapı, istihdam ve dayanıklılık sağlamasının önemini vurguladı.

items.title: US envoys head to meet Zelensky after talks with Putin in Moscow
items.summary: US envoy Steve Witkoff says President Putin has agreed to European negotiators joining the next round of Ukraine talks.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: US envoys head to meet Zelensky after talks with Putin in Moscow
items.summaryTr: US envoy Steve Witkoff says President Putin has agreed to European negotiators joining the next round of Ukraine talks.
items.articleText: US envoys head to meet Zelensky after talks with Putin in Moscow - Published US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff held a fresh round of talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow, a day after the latest discussions aimed at ending the war in Ukraine wrapped up in Abu Dhabi. The pair are now flying to Dublin to meet Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky, and Witkoff said a new round of trilateral talks had already been agreed with Putin. Earlier on Thursday Zelensky said Ukraine's military was again facing "systematic" restrictions to Starlink's military-grade satellite service, Starshield, meaning Kyiv was struggling to intercept Russian jet-powered drones. The talks in the Emirates were framed as being centred around European security arrangements in a post-war scenario, although a resolution to the war sparked by Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022 still appears distant. Comments by both President Vladimir Putin and Kremlin officials suggest that Russia's position on the war has not shifted, and that Moscow's demands for territory and neutrality continue to far exceed what Ukraine is prepared to consider. Witkoff said that Europeans would join the next round of talks. "They are our partners and it's important to us that they take part," Witkoff told Russian state TV after meeting Putin in the Kremlin. Zelensky said Ukraine was trying to clear up the Starlink situation with the American side but added "some things" were already clear: "If someone in America is making decisions that basically treat Ukrainian territory as if it is not Ukrainian, then this tells us where things are going." He did not elaborate further. Starshield was developed by Elon Musk's SpaceX company for government and military use. Along with Starlink, it has come to play a vital role in facilitating communication on Ukraine's front line. A similar issue with connectivity affected the front line in late October and lasted about a week before it was fixed and it remained unclear who had ordered the temporary restrictions. - Why is Ukraine so reliant on Starlink and can Europe plug the gap? - Published25 October Zelensky said the current disruption had been ongoing for several days and was "helping the Russians kill more Ukrainians and carry out more accurate strikes against Ukraine". Meanwhile, some of the longstanding roadblocks in the peace process were addressed during the US-Russia talks in the Kremlin. The territorial issue continues to be a key point of contention, Putin said. "For us there is only one line of demarcation: the line of the state border. Because then it will be clear that we are here, and you are there. As soon as we start discussing 'grey zones'… arguments immediately start and any agreements become unstable. And there will be no lasting peace." He also suggested organising a humanitarian truce to allow for the evacuation of hundreds of civilians from a frontline area, on the model of last month's ceasefire in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky. Putin suggested a similar five-day ceasefire for Kostyantynivka, a contested front-line Ukrainian city in the eastern region of Donetsk. Kyiv disputes that Russia fully holds the town, and a truce could help Moscow's troops to make a final push to seize it. "Considering that they brought in equipment and rotated troops in Oleshky under the guise of a humanitarian operation, it's clear what they want in Kostyantynivka," Ukrainian presidential adviser Dmitry Lytvyn told the BBC, adding that the details would need to be "clarified". But at the core of this week's talks has been the issue of European security architecture. Earlier Kushner said the US hoped to "create a new framework" of security between Ukraine, Russia and Europe that could "secure lasting peace", while Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov said it was "clear that the current system does not work." Ukraine and Europe have long been concerned about the current US administration's commitment to European security and its softening towards the Kremlin and that decisions about their continent could be made without them. Zelensky said he found the US approach of discussing a new European security order with Russia "a bit strange". "It is a significant shift in the US position that the US has now taken on board the Russian demand that the European security architecture needs to be discussed and agreed upon in parallel with the Ukraine peace talks," said the Director of the Estonian Foreign Policy Institute Kristi Raik. She said the Russians have a "long history" of wanting to revise European security architecture, intended as core principles "like sovereignty, territorial integrity, the principle that there is no use of force to some conflicts". Russia "has long looked to reduced Nato presence on the Eastern flank and that… get some kind of veto rights in decisions concerning European security and defence," Raik said. "And that's where it gets even more difficult to imagine that there could be an agreement between the Europeans and the Russians." On Thursday, Putin again repeated that the presence of foreign troops in Ukraine was "unacceptable" to Russia, and said Russia would like the Americans to engage with Europe "so that the Europeans can decide what they truly want: peace or war". During the first years of the war, Europeans cut communications with the Kremlin and refused to engage with Russia directly. That position has now shifted for many as concern that decisions about the European continent could be made without European involvement. Kushner also urged Europe to "identify one person to speak on their behalf" in the negotiations. But the Kremlin has not confirmed the make-up of next week's talks, and at the start of the meeting, Putin had indicated he didn't want European countries to play a full role. The Russians have long cited Europe's support for Kyiv as an obstacle to their involvement. Speaking to Kushner and Witkoff, Putin said he was encouraging them "to work with your European allies so that they finally decide whether they want peace or war in Ukraine." Related topics - Published15 October

items.title: Trump'tan Nvidia'nın yeni CEO'su için sürpriz öneri: Apple'dan o ismi işaret etti
items.summary: ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Jensen Huang'ın istifasının ardından Nvidia CEO'luğu için Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook'u önerdi. Trump, "Bir efsanenin yerini başka bir efsane alıyor" ifadelerini kullandı.

items.titleTr: Trump'tan Nvidia'nın yeni CEO'su için sürpriz öneri: Apple'dan o ismi işaret etti
items.summaryTr: ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Jensen Huang'ın istifasının ardından Nvidia CEO'luğu için Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook'u önerdi. Trump, "Bir efsanenin yerini başka bir efsane alıyor" ifadelerini kullandı.
items.articleText: Trump'tan Nvidia'nın yeni CEO'su için sürpriz öneri: Apple'dan o ismi işaret etti - ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Jensen Huang'ın istifasının ardından Nvidia CEO'luğu için Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook'u önerdi. - Trump, "Bir efsanenin yerini başka bir efsane alıyor." ifadelerini kullandı. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang'ın görevinden ayrılmasının ardından şirketin yeni CEO'su için dikkat çeken bir isim önerdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Trump, Truth Social hesabından yaptığı paylaşımda, Huang'ın görev süresince "harika" işler yaptığını belirterek, yerine Apple Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Tim Cook'un geçmesi gerektiğini savundu. Trump, "Jensen Huang istifa ettiğine göre, onun yerini alabilecek tek bir kişi var, Apple'dan Tim Cook. Bir efsanenin yerini başka bir efsane alıyor." değerlendirmesinde bulundu. Nvidia'da geçici CEO Colette Kress oldu Nvidia, Jensen Huang'ın başkanlık, üst yöneticilik ve yönetim kurulu üyeliği görevlerinden derhal geçerli olmak üzere ayrıldığını açıklamıştı. Şirketin başkan yardımcısı ve Finans Direktörü (CFO) Colette Kress'in geçici CEO olarak görev yapmayı kabul ettiği bildirilmişti. Huang'ın istifası, hakkında evlilik dışı iki ilişki yaşadığına ilişkin haberlerin ardından geldi. Söz konusu haberlerde, kadınlardan birinin Çin adına istihbarat topladığı da iddia edilmişti.

items.title: Zelenskiy Avrupa'yı devreye sokmak istiyor: Rusya ile görüşmelerde yeni talep
items.summary: Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy, Rusya-Ukrayna savaşının sona erdirilmesine yönelik müzakerelerde Avrupa'nın daimi olarak yer alması gerektiğini söyledi. Zelenskiy, hava savunması ve enerji desteği için Avrupalı liderlere çağrıda bulundu.

items.articleText: Zelenskiy Avrupa'yı devreye sokmak istiyor: Rusya ile görüşmelerde yeni talep - Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy, Rusya-Ukrayna savaşının sona erdirilmesine yönelik müzakerelerde Avrupa'nın daimi olarak yer alması gerektiğini söyledi. - Zelenskiy, hava savunması ve enerji desteği için Avrupalı liderlere çağrıda bulundu. Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy, Avrupa'nın Rusya-Ukrayna savaşını sona erdirmeye yönelik müzakerelerde kalıcı şekilde yer alması gerektiğini belirtti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İrlanda'nın başkenti Dublin'de düzenlenen Avrupa Siyasi Topluluğu (AST) 9. Zirvesi'nin açılışında konuşan Zelenskiy, Rusya'da bulunan ABD heyetinin akşam saatlerinde Dublin'e geleceğini ve görüşmelerin sonuçlarını burada ele alacaklarını bildirdi. Avrupa'nın Rusya'nın da bulunduğu müzakere masasında doğrudan yer almasa da sürece dolaylı biçimde dahil olmasını olumlu değerlendiren Zelenskiy, "Avrupa'nın müzakerelerin daimi unsuru olmasını sağlamalıyız." dedi. Abu Dabi görüşmelerinde esir takası gündemdeydi Birleşik Arap Emirlikleri'nin (BAE) başkenti Abu Dabi'de gerçekleştirilen görüşmelerin ciddi geçtiğini belirten Zelenskiy, esir takası konusunda sağlanan mutabakatın önemine dikkati çekti. Güvenlik garantilerine ilişkin görüşmelerde Avrupa ile Rusya arasında yeni bir güvenlik mimarisi oluşturulması ihtimalinin de gündeme geldiğini aktaran Zelenskiy, bu yaklaşımı "tuhaf" bulduklarını ifade etti. Ukrayna heyetinin Karadeniz'de gerilimi azaltacak ve enerji altyapısına yönelik saldırıları durduracak adımlar önerdiğini belirten Zelenskiy, Rus heyetinin bu konuları görüşme yetkisi bulunmadığını söylediğini aktardı. Zelenskiy'den Patriot, NASAMS ve F-16 mühimmatı talebi Ukrayna'nın öncelikleri arasında hava savunma sistemleri için mühimmat tedariki ve enerji ihtiyacının karşılanmasının bulunduğunu belirten Zelenskiy, Patriot ve NASAMS sistemleri ile F-16 savaş uçakları için mühimmat desteğine ihtiyaç duyduklarını söyledi. Zelenskiy, bu başlıklarda Avrupalı liderlerden destek istedi.

Güvenlik garantilerine ilişkin görüşmelerde Avrupa ile Rusya arasında yeni bir güvenlik mimarisi oluşturulması ihtimalinin de gündeme geldiğini aktaran Zelenskiy, bu yaklaşımı "tuhaf" bulduklarını ifade etti. Ukrayna heyetinin Karadeniz'de gerilimi azaltacak ve enerji altyapısına yönelik saldırıları durduracak adımlar önerdiğini belirten Zelenskiy, Rus heyetinin bu konuları görüşme yetkisi bulunmadığını söylediğini aktardı. Zelenskiy'den Patriot, NASAMS ve F-16 mühimmatı talebi Ukrayna'nın öncelikleri arasında hava savunma sistemleri için mühimmat tedariki ve enerji ihtiyacının karşılanmasının bulunduğunu belirten Zelenskiy, Patriot ve NASAMS sistemleri ile F-16 savaş uçakları için mühimmat desteğine ihtiyaç duyduklarını söyledi. Zelenskiy, bu başlıklarda Avrupalı liderlerden destek istedi.

items.articleText: Antalya'daki zirvede dikkat çeken çıkış: Pezeşkiyan'dan ABD'ye diz çökme mesajı - İran Cumhurbaşkanı Mesud Pezeşkiyan, ABD'nin baskılarla İran halkını diz çöktürmeye çalıştığını belirterek, "Kendisi yavaş yavaş diz çöküyor." dedi. - Pezeşkiyan, Antalya'daki COP31 kapsamında gerçekleştirdiği görüşmelerin olumlu geçtiğini söyledi. İran Cumhurbaşkanı Mesud Pezeşkiyan, Antalya'da düzenlenen Birleşmiş Milletler (BM) İklim Değişikliği Çerçeve Sözleşmesi 31. Taraflar Konferansı (COP31) Liderler Zirvesi kapsamında yaptığı temasları değerlendirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İran devlet televizyonuna konuşan Pezeşkiyan, zirvede İran'ın görüşlerini ifade etme fırsatı bulduklarını belirterek, çeşitli ülkelerin cumhurbaşkanları ve dışişleri bakanlarıyla gerçekleştirdiği görüşmelerin olumlu geçtiğini kaydetti. Görüşmelerde işbirliği imkanlarının ele alındığını ve diyalogun gelecekte de sürmesini umduğunu ifade eden Pezeşkiyan, ABD'nin İran'a yönelik baskılarına ilişkin dikkat çeken açıklamalarda bulundu. Pezeşkiyan, ABD'nin uyguladığı baskılarla İran halkını diz çöktürmeye çalıştığını ancak kendisinin yavaş yavaş diz çöktüğünü savundu. "İran halkının geleceği için çalışmalıyız" İran halkının ekonomik ve sosyal koşullarının iyileştirilmesinin öncelikleri olduğunu belirten Pezeşkiyan, "Bizim için önemli olan, İran halkının geçim sorunu, hayatı ve geleceğiyle ilgili olarak neler yapmamız gerektiğidir. İnsanların umutlu olmasını istiyoruz." ifadelerini kullandı. Erdoğan ile de görüştü Pezeşkiyan, Antalya'daki zirvede yaptığı konuşmanın yanı sıra Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ile ikili görüşme gerçekleştirdi. İran Cumhurbaşkanı ayrıca Irak ve Brezilya cumhurbaşkanları, Pakistan, Ermenistan ve Norveç başbakanları ile Irak Kürt Bölgesel Yönetimi Başkanı'yla da bir araya geldi.

items.summary: IMF Sözcüsü Julie Kozack, ABD'de enflasyonun yüzde 2'lik hedefe 2028'in ortasında gerilemesini beklediklerini açıkladı. Kozack, yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki olası değişimlerin de enflasyon üzerinde etkili olabileceğini belirtti.

items.titleTr: Enflasyon ne zaman düşecek? IMF, ABD için tarihi açıkladı
items.summaryTr: IMF Sözcüsü Julie Kozack, ABD'de enflasyonun yüzde 2'lik hedefe 2028'in ortasında gerilemesini beklediklerini açıkladı. Kozack, yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki olası değişimlerin de enflasyon üzerinde etkili olabileceğini belirtti.
items.articleText: Enflasyon ne zaman düşecek? IMF, ABD için tarihi açıkladı - IMF Sözcüsü Julie Kozack, ABD'de enflasyonun yüzde 2'lik hedefe 2028'in ortasında gerilemesini beklediklerini açıkladı. - Kozack, yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki olası değişimlerin de enflasyon üzerinde etkili olabileceğini belirtti. Uluslararası Para Fonu (IMF) Sözcüsü Julie Kozack, ABD'de enflasyonun yüzde 2'lik hedefe 2028'in ortasında ulaşmasını beklediklerini bildirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Basın toplantısında küresel ekonomiye ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulunan Kozack, ABD'de manşet enflasyonun hedefin üzerinde kalmaya devam ettiğini söyledi. Bu durumun Ortadoğu'daki savaşın yol açtığı emtia fiyatı şoku ve hizmet sektöründeki katı enflasyondan kaynaklandığını belirten Kozack, mevcut tahminlerin enflasyonun 2028'in ortasında yüzde 2'ye gerileyeceğine işaret ettiğini kaydetti. Son dönemdeki enflasyonist baskıların artan iş gücü maliyetlerinden kaynaklandığını düşünmediklerini ifade eden Kozack, enflasyonun hedefin üzerinde kalmasının arkasında başka faktörlerin bulunduğunu dile getirdi. IMF'den Fed'in sıkı para politikasına destek Kozack, ABD Merkez Bankasının (Fed) para politikasında sıkılaştırma sürecini uygun şekilde başlattığını belirtti. Dezenflasyon sürecinin desteklenmesi ve enflasyonun yeniden hedefe çekilmesi için önümüzdeki dönemde kısıtlayıcı para politikası duruşunun gerekli olacağını söyleyen Kozack, Fed'in fiyat istikrarına odaklanmasını ve gerektiğinde harekete geçmeye hazır olmasını desteklediklerini vurguladı. Yapay zeka yatırımları enflasyonu etkileyebilir Yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki olası değişimlerin enflasyona etkisine de değinen Kozack, enerji fiyatlarındaki şok ile yapay zeka yatırımlarındaki patlamanın küresel ekonomiyi etkileyen iki önemli güç olduğunu söyledi. Bu iki gelişmenin küresel büyümeyi farklı yönlere çektiğini ancak her ikisinin de enflasyonist etkiler yaratabildiğini belirten Kozack, yapay zeka yatırımlarına ilişkin beklentilerdeki olası bir değişikliğin enflasyonu da etkileyebileceğini ifade etti. IMF'nin yapay zekanın finansal istikrar üzerindeki olası risklerini yakından izlediğini aktaran Kozack, özellikle siber riskler, piyasa hareketleri ve hisse senedi piyasalarındaki oynaklığa odaklandıklarını kaydetti. Yüksek piyasa değerlemeleri yakından izleniyor Kozack, bazı piyasalarda değerlemelerin yüksek seviyelerde kalmayı sürdürdüğüne dikkati çekti. Yapay zeka yatırımlarının uzun vadeli kârlılığına ilişkin beklentilerin yeniden değerlendirilmesinin piyasalarda risk oluşturabileceğini belirten Kozack, bu alandaki gelişmeleri yakından takip ettiklerini söyledi. IMF Sözcüsü, yapay zekanın küresel büyümeyi destekleme potansiyelinin yanı sıra verimlilik, iş gücü piyasaları ve finansal istikrar üzerindeki olası etkilerinin de kurumun gündeminde olduğunu bildirdi.

items.title: Putin-Trump hattında kritik gelişme: Ukrayna için yeni toplantı tarihi
items.summary: ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın Özel Temsilcisi Steve Witkoff, Rusya Devlet Başkanı Vladimir Putin ile Moskova'da gerçekleştirdiği görüşmenin ardından ilerleme kaydedildiğini açıkladı. Witkoff, üçlü görüşmelerin yeniden başlayacağını ve yeni bir toplantı tarihi belirlendiğini bildirdi.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Putin-Trump hattında kritik gelişme: Ukrayna için yeni toplantı tarihi
items.summaryTr: ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın Özel Temsilcisi Steve Witkoff, Rusya Devlet Başkanı Vladimir Putin ile Moskova'da gerçekleştirdiği görüşmenin ardından ilerleme kaydedildiğini açıkladı. Witkoff, üçlü görüşmelerin yeniden başlayacağını ve yeni bir toplantı tarihi belirlendiğini bildirdi.
items.articleText: Putin-Trump hattında kritik gelişme: Ukrayna için yeni toplantı tarihi - ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın Özel Temsilcisi Steve Witkoff, Rusya Devlet Başkanı Vladimir Putin ile Moskova'da gerçekleştirdiği görüşmenin ardından ilerleme kaydedildiğini açıkladı. - Witkoff, üçlü görüşmelerin yeniden başlayacağını ve yeni bir toplantı tarihi belirlendiğini bildirdi. Rusya Devlet Başkanı Vladimir Putin ile ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın Özel Temsilcisi Steve Witkoff, Moskova'da bir araya geldi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Görüşmenin ardından Vnukovo Havalimanı'nda basın mensuplarına açıklamalarda bulunan Witkoff, temaslarda ilerleme sağlandığını söyledi. CNN'in haberine göre Witkoff, müzakerelerin yeniden başlamasının önemli bir gelişme olduğunu belirterek, "İnsanlar üçlü görüşmeleri yeniden başlatacağımızı düşünmüyordu. Yeniden başlattık. Yeni bir toplantı tarihi belirledik." ifadelerini kullandı. Yeni görüşmelere Avrupalı temsilciler de katılacak Witkoff, gelecek görüşmelere Avrupalı temsilcilerin de katılacağını doğruladı. Avrupa temsilcilerinin müzakere sürecinde yer almasının önemli olduğunu vurguladı. Görüşmede Trump'ın damadı ve Özel Temsilcisi Jared Kushner de yer aldı. Kushner, temasların kapsamlı ve ayrıntılı geçtiğini belirterek, yapılan görüşmelerin ilerideki çok taraflı toplantılara katkı sağlamasını umduğunu söyledi. ABD heyeti Zelenskiy ile görüşecek Moskova'daki temasların ardından ABD temsilcilerinin İrlanda'nın başkenti Dublin'e gitmesi bekleniyor. Heyetin burada Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Volodimir Zelenskiy ile bir araya gelerek Putin ile yapılan görüşmenin sonuçları hakkında bilgi vermesi öngörülüyor. Görüşmelerin ardından Ukrayna'daki savaşın sona erdirilmesine yönelik diplomatik sürecin nasıl ilerleyeceği ve yeni toplantının hangi tarihte yapılacağı takip edilecek. Ukrayna'daki savaşın sona erdirilmesine yönelik diplomatik temaslarda ABD, Rusya ve Ukrayna arasındaki görüşmelerin yanı sıra Avrupa ülkelerinin sürece katılımı da önem taşıyor. Yeni toplantıya Avrupalı temsilcilerin dahil edilmesi, müzakerelerin daha geniş bir çerçevede yürütülmesine yönelik bir adım olarak öne çıkıyor.

Özel emir, hisse senedinde alıcı ve satıcının karşılıklı anlaşmasıyla, borsada o anda oluşan fiyatlardan bağımsız olarak belirlenen fiyat üzerinden gerçekleştirilen işlemdir. items.title: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say
items.summary: The proposed radical overhaul of the welfare system would move under-25s off the main sickness benefits.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say
items.summaryTr: The proposed radical overhaul of the welfare system would move under-25s off the main sickness benefits.
items.articleText: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say - Published Some young people could see reductions to the benefits they are entitled to under a radical overhaul of the welfare system to be recommended by a government-commissioned review. As reported in the Times,, external Alan Milburn's year-long report, to be published on Tuesday, is expected to recommend moving under-25s off the main sickness and disability benefits. Milburn, a former Labour health secretary, has been tasked by the government with helping reduce the one in eight 16 to 24 year-olds in the UK who are not in education, employment or training - otherwise known as "Neet". He said on Wednesday night that his plans would not be "pain-free" and would affect both existing and new claimants. His report is expected to say that under-25s should no longer be able to claim the health element of UK-wide universal credit - or personal independence payment (Pip), the main disability benefit in England and Wales. Disabled people in Scotland can claim the devolved Adult Disability Payment. Instead, under Milburn's plan, under-25s would receive an allowance on the same basic rate as universal credit. Some could be eligible for a new "additional cost allowance" to cover day-to-day costs related to their conditions. Some claimants would receive less under the plans - although the exact amounts will not be clear until early next year, when the government publishes legislation to implement the changes. People can claim Pip to help them with the additional cost of being disabled or living with long-term physical or mental health conditions. It is available to those both in and out of work. In his interim report,, external Milburn said survey data found that 19% of young people claiming disability or health benefits were in work. Milburn, a Labour MP from 1992 to 2010, is also expected to recommend an investment of billions into more employment support for young people, including work placements, job subsidies and one-to-one personal advisers. Those with more severe disabilities and unable to work would get a new benefit paid at a higher rate. Milburn told the Times: "Candidly, it could mean that some people will get less financial support at the beginning of their benefit claim than under the current system. "But actually, for young people, there's a different debate that we've got to resolve, which is whether the priority is their longer-term life chances or just their immediate shorter-term finances. "I think what the current system does [is] it prioritises the latter over the former. I believe that's the wrong choice and it needs to be the other way around." Just under one million young people in the UK are Neets, data from the Office for National Statistics (ONS) from April to June suggests. This was a rise of 3% on the same period last year. Milburn's recommendations are likely to be backed by Prime Minister Andy Burnham but could prove controversial among Labour MPs, who opposed welfare changes last year under his predecessor Sir Keir Starmer. Dame Meg Hillier, who helped spearhead a backbench rebellion against Starmer's reforms, suggested she and her colleagues were broadly supportive this time around. "What happened last year was a cut was being proposed and none of us could explain to people what would happen to them," the Labour MP told the BBC. "Milburn has done some very good work on this so I'm giving him a fair wind," she added. But Bell Ribeiro-Addy, one of the Labour backbenchers who revolted last year, said she was "not sure" she could vote to cut the benefit entitlement of existing claimants. 'Cannot assume' Tom Ashforth, a 19-year-old student at Sheffield Hallam University, receives both components of Pip at the higher rate. He said the financial support helps him manage additional expenses linked to his visual impairment, including prescriptions, mobility aids and accessible learning resources. "If I were to lose it, I would struggle to afford essential things," he said. He said he believes decisions over disability benefits should be made on a case-by-case basis, rather than according to age. "You cannot assume that everyone under the age of 25 is in the same position," he said. In his Times interview, Milburn acknowledged that changing the rules for existing claimants would be "difficult politically" but stressed it was necessary. 'Rebuilding system from scratch' James Taylor, from disability equality charity Scope, said Pip was a "lifeline" and restricting access to it "won't make young disabled people's extra costs disappear". Harriet Edwards, from the charity Sense, said changes were "long overdue", but that without additional details, families were "deeply anxious". A government spokesperson said: "We will always ensure there is a safety net for the most vulnerable and those who are unable to work." The reforms would represent a radical overhaul of Britain's welfare system, at a time when there is heavy political pressure for the UK to find the money to spend more on defence. Both the Conservatives and Reform UK have argued for significant cuts to welfare, including to fund a boost to defence. Responding on Thursday, Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said the government should not be spending "lots of time" on employment schemes, which she said would ultimately fail. If Milburn's recommendations were approved, it could take almost a decade for the British state to see monetary savings. The new system "will need significant investment" and would involve "rebuilding the system from scratch", Milburn said. His new proposed system would involve an element of carrot and stick, wherein young people could lose some of their benefits if they did not engage with the extra work support options. In an interview recorded on Tuesday, Skills Minister Jacqui Smith told the BBC that young people had a "responsibility" to take up employment support. "It is a contract. People need the chance, and they need to take that chance," she added. A separate review - co-chaired by disabilities minister Sir Stephen Timms - examining disability benefits is also expected to be published this month. items.summary: İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi (İBB) Meclisi'nde, 19 ilçe belediyesinin 2027 yılı bütçesi kabul edildi. Kadıköy 19,1 milyar lirayla en yüksek bütçeye sahip ilçe olurken, Şile 3,5 milyar lirayla listenin son sırasında yer aldı.

items.articleText: İstanbul'da 19 ilçenin bütçe sıralaması belli oldu: Zirvede hangi belediye var? İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi (İBB) Meclisi'nde, 19 ilçe belediyesinin 2027 yılı bütçesi kabul edildi. Kadıköy 19,1 milyar lirayla en yüksek bütçeye sahip ilçe olurken, Şile 3,5 milyar lirayla listenin son sırasında yer aldı. İstanbul'da 19 ilçenin 2027 bütçesi kabul edildi İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi (İBB) Meclisi'nde, 19 ilçe belediyesinin 2027 mali yılı bütçeleri kabul edildi. İBB Meclisi kasım ayı toplantılarının üçüncü oturumu, Meclis 2. Başkanvekili Gencay Özcan başkanlığında Saraçhane'deki belediye binasında gerçekleştirildi. Toplantıda Gaziosmanpaşa, Küçükçekmece, Sultanbeyli ve Üsküdar'ın da aralarında bulunduğu 19 ilçenin gelecek yıl için hazırlanan bütçeleri görüşüldü. Yapılan oylamanın ardından bütçelerin tamamı kabul edildi. Kadıköy ilk sırada, Şile son sırada Kabul edilen bütçeler arasında en yüksek tutar 19 milyar 100 milyon lirayla Kadıköy Belediyesi'ne ait oldu. Kadıköy'ü 16,5 milyar lirayla Ümraniye ve 16,2 milyar lirayla Üsküdar izledi. Şile Belediyesi ise 3 milyar 520 milyon 674 bin liralık bütçeyle listede en düşük bütçeye sahip ilçe oldu. 19 ilçenin 2027 yılı bütçeleri İBB Meclisinde kabul edilen ilçe belediyelerinin 2027 yılı bütçeleri şöyle: İlçe belediyelerinin yıllık bütçeleri; personel giderleri, altyapı yatırımları, sosyal hizmetler, ulaşım ve kentsel hizmetler gibi harcama kalemlerini kapsıyor. 2027 bütçeleri, belediyelerin gelecek yılki hizmet ve yatırım planlarının mali çerçevesini oluşturacak.
